final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless workflow that publishes custom events from an AWS Step Functions state
  machine to a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus, plus an EventBridge rule on that
  bus that forwards every event to a CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and
  debugging. Every resource is created inside this template.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: serverless-workflow
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must start with a letter or a number.
    Description: Name prefix applied to every resource created by this template.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name applied to every resource created by this template.

  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days that events and state machine execution logs are retained.

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key that encrypts the workflow CloudWatch Logs data
  #############################################################################
  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} workflow log data'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-workflow-logs-key'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToEncryptLogData
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToUseKeyForDeliveredEvents
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Custom EventBridge event bus
  #############################################################################
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-bus'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Destination log group that receives every event placed on the custom bus
  #############################################################################
  EventDestinationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-all-events'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Resource policy that allows EventBridge to write to that log group
  #############################################################################
  EventDestinationLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-eventbridge-log-writes'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AllowEventBridgeToWriteEvents",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventDestinationLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  #############################################################################
  # Rule on the custom bus that matches every custom event and logs it
  #############################################################################
  AllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-events-to-logs'
      Description: Forwards every custom event placed on the custom event bus to CloudWatch Logs.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Id: EventDestinationLogGroupTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventDestinationLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Log group for Step Functions execution logging
  #############################################################################
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-execution'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Execution role assumed by the state machine
  #############################################################################
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-states-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role for the serverless workflow state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-states-execution-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishCustomEventsToEventBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
              - Sid: WriteStateMachineExecutionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: ManageCloudWatchLogDeliveries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  #############################################################################
  # Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events to the bus
  #############################################################################
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
        EventSourceName: !Sub '${ProjectName}.${Environment}.workflow'
        EventDetailType: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-custom-event'
      Definition:
        Comment: 'Publishes a custom event to the custom EventBridge event bus ${EventBusArn}.'
        StartAt: PublishCustomEvent
        States:
          PublishCustomEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents'
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - Source: '${EventSourceName}'
                  DetailType: '${EventDetailType}'
                  Detail:
                    project: '${ProjectName}'
                    environment: '${Environment}'
                    message: 'Custom event published by the serverless workflow state machine.'
                  EventBusName: '${EventBusName}'
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 3
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  DestinationLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives every event from the custom bus.
    Value: !Ref EventDestinationLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Cloud WAN global network and core network used for centralized outbound
  traffic inspection. Creates the global network together with the core network
  and its policy (production/development segments, inspection network function
  group, tag-based attachment policies and segment actions), plus an inspection
  VPC with CMK-encrypted VPC Flow Logs and a Cloud WAN VPC attachment that
  enables appliance mode.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: core
    Description: Environment tag value applied to the resources created by this template.
  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudwan-centralized-inspection
    Description: Project tag value applied to the resources created by this template.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: network-team
    Description: Owner tag value applied to the resources created by this template.
  CoreNetworkAsnRange:
    Type: String
    Default: '64512-65534'
    Description: ASN range assigned to the Cloud WAN core network edge locations.
  SecondaryEdgeRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: >-
      Additional Cloud WAN edge location region attached to the global network.
      Must be different from the region the stack is deployed in.
  InspectionVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.0.0/16
    Description: >-
      CIDR block for the inspection VPC created by this template. If this value
      is changed, the four static subnet CIDR blocks defined on the inspection
      subnets must also be updated so they remain contained within this range.
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    Description: Retention period in days for the inspection VPC flow log group.

Resources:

  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'AWS Cloud WAN global network for ${Project} centralized outbound traffic inspection'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  # The core network policy is delivered through the PolicyDocument property of
  # AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork; there is no standalone policy resource type.
  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Description: !Sub 'AWS Cloud WAN core network for ${Project} centralized outbound traffic inspection'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
      PolicyDocument:
        version: '2021.12'
        core-network-configuration:
          asn-ranges:
            - !Ref CoreNetworkAsnRange
          edge-locations:
            - location: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
            - location: !Ref SecondaryEdgeRegion
        segments:
          - name: production
            description: Production segment; attachments are isolated to this segment only.
            isolate-attachments: true
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: development
            description: Development segment; attachments are not isolated.
            isolate-attachments: false
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: default
            description: Catch-all segment for attachments that match no attachment policy rule.
            isolate-attachments: false
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        network-function-groups:
          - name: inspection
            description: Network function group that hosts the inspection VPC attachments.
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            description: Associate inspection VPC attachments with the inspection network function group.
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                operator: equals
                key: domain
                value: inspection
            action:
              association-method: constant
              network-function-group: inspection
          - rule-number: 200
            description: Associate production attachments with the production segment.
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                operator: equals
                key: domain
                value: production
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: production
          - rule-number: 300
            description: Associate development attachments with the development segment.
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                operator: equals
                key: domain
                value: development
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: development
        segment-actions:
          # The action name ("send-to") and the "via" block follow the Cloud WAN policy
          # schema used to route segment traffic through a network function group.
          # Verify the exact action value against the current policy schema at deploy time.
          - action: send-to
            segment: production
            via:
              network-function-groups:
                - inspection
          - action: send-to
            segment: development
            via:
              network-function-groups:
                - inspection

  InspectionVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref InspectionVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-vpc'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  InspectionFlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK used to encrypt the ${Project} inspection VPC flow log group'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministerKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryptFlowLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                # Derived from the log group name so the key policy does not depend on
                # !GetAtt of the log group (which would create a dependency cycle).
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${Project}-inspection-vpc-flow-logs:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  InspectionFlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${Project}-inspection-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref InspectionFlowLogKmsKey

  InspectionFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt InspectionFlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  InspectionFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-vpc-flow-logs'
      Description: Role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs delivery service for the inspection VPC.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  InspectionFlowLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-vpc-flow-logs'
      Roles:
        - !Ref InspectionFlowLogRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogDeliveryToLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt InspectionFlowLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${InspectionFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogEncryptionWithCmk
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt InspectionFlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  InspectionVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref InspectionFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt InspectionFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  InspectionInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InspectionInternetGateway

  InspectionPublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      # Static block inside the inspection VPC CIDR (10.10.0.0/16).
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-public-a'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      # Static block inside the inspection VPC CIDR (10.10.0.0/16).
      CidrBlock: 10.10.16.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-public-b'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      # Static block inside the inspection VPC CIDR (10.10.0.0/16).
      CidrBlock: 10.10.32.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-private-a'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      # Static block inside the inspection VPC CIDR (10.10.0.0/16).
      CidrBlock: 10.10.48.0/20
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-private-b'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InspectionVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InspectionInternetGateway

  InspectionPublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionPublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPublicRouteTable

  InspectionPublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionPublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPublicRouteTable

  InspectionNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InspectionVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt InspectionNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionPublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  InspectionPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref InspectionNatGateway

  InspectionPrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionPrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPrivateRouteTable

  InspectionPrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionPrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionPrivateRouteTable

  InspectionSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Security group for the ${Project} inspection VPC'
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref InspectionVpcCidr
          Description: Allow all traffic within the inspection VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Project}-inspection-sg'
        - Key: domain

  Name:
    Type: String

    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'

    Description: >-

  Message:
    Type: String
    Default: Hello from CloudFormation
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: >-
      Custom message stored in the SSM parameter value and echoed in the Greeting output.
  Timestamp:
    Type: String
    Default: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

      Explicit ISO-8601 timestamp value recorded in the WaitConditionHandle metadata, because
      CloudFormation exposes no native timestamp pseudo-parameter.

Resources:
  ApprovalTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Metadata:
      Purpose: template-approval-test

    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key used to encrypt the template approval test SNS topic for stack ${AWS::StackName}.'

        Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Step Functions STANDARD state machine that first writes an item to a DynamoDB
  table and then reads that item back by its id, returning only the retrieved
  item as the workflow output. The table is encrypted with a customer-managed
  KMS key and has point-in-time recovery enabled.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used by the workflow.

Resources:

  TableEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used for DynamoDB table encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  TableEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-table-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableEncryptionKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sfn-dynamodb-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDbItemAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutAndGetItemOnTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Sid: UseTableEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-item-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "Comment": "Put an item into DynamoDB and then read it back by id.",
              "StartAt": "PutItem",
              "States": {
                "PutItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Item": {
                      "id": {
                        "S.$": "$.id"
                      },
                      "description": {
                        "S.$": "States.Format('Item {} stored in DynamoDB', $.id)"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": null,
                  "Next": "GetItem"
                },
                "GetItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Key": {
                      "id": {
                        "S.$": "$.id"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "OutputPath": "$.Item",
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - TableName: !Ref Table

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the created Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Name

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table written to and read by the workflow.
    Value: !Ref Table

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table written to and read by the workflow.
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn

  StateMachineRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the execution role assumed by the state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  TableEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the table.
    Value: !GetAtt TableEncryptionKey.Arn

  TableEncryptionKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the table.
    Value: !Ref TableEncryptionKeyAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment using AWS CodeDeploy blue-green traffic
  shifting with automated before/after validation hooks. Creates the main Lambda
  function, an immutable version, a live alias, two validation hook functions, the
  supporting IAM roles, and a CodeDeploy application/deployment group configured for
  canary traffic shifting.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-bluegreen-cicd
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix applied to all resources created by this stack.

  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.

  LambdaLogLevel:
    Type: String
    Default: INFO
    AllowedValues:
      - DEBUG
      - INFO
      - WARNING
      - ERROR
    Description: Log level injected into the main function as the LOG_LEVEL environment variable.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role for the main Lambda function
  ##############################################################################
  MainFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-main-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the main blue-green Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MainFunctionRuntimeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadOwnFunctionConfiguration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:GetAlias
                  - lambda:ListAliases
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ApplicationName}-main*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # Main Lambda function
  ##############################################################################
  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-main'
      Description: Main application function deployed with CodeDeploy blue-green traffic shifting.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LambdaLogLevel
          APPLICATION_NAME: !Ref ApplicationName
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref EnvironmentTag
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          LOG_LEVEL = os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO').upper()
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(LOG_LEVEL)


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(json.dumps({
                  'application': os.environ.get('APPLICATION_NAME'),
                  'environment': os.environ.get('ENVIRONMENT'),
                  'event': event,
              }))
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Hello from the main blue-green Lambda function'}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # Immutable published version used by CodeDeploy blue-green deployments
  ##############################################################################
  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: Immutable snapshot of the main function published for CodeDeploy blue-green deployments.

  ##############################################################################
  # Live alias - the traffic shifting target for CodeDeploy
  ##############################################################################
  LiveAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version
      Description: Live alias used as the CodeDeploy blue-green traffic shifting target.

  ##############################################################################
  # Shared IAM role for the validation hook functions
  ##############################################################################
  HookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-hook-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the CodeDeploy validation hook Lambda functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReportDeploymentLifecycleStatus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # Pre-traffic (BeforeAllowTraffic) validation hook
  ##############################################################################
  PreTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-pre-traffic-hook'
      Description: BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook invoked by CodeDeploy before traffic is shifted.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LambdaLogLevel
          HOOK_STAGE: before-allow-traffic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          LOG_LEVEL = os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO').upper()
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(LOG_LEVEL)

          codedeploy = boto3.client('codedeploy')


          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event['DeploymentId']
              hook_execution_id = event['LifecycleEventHookExecutionId']

              logger.info(json.dumps({
                  'stage': os.environ.get('HOOK_STAGE'),
                  'deploymentId': deployment_id,
                  'lifecycleEventHookExecutionId': hook_execution_id,
              }))

              status = 'Succeeded'
              try:
                  # Perform pre-traffic validation here (for example, invoke the new
                  # version through the live alias and assert on the response).
                  logger.info('Pre-traffic validation passed.')
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.error('Pre-traffic validation failed: %s', exc)
                  status = 'Failed'

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status,
              )

              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'status': status})}
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # Post-traffic (AfterAllowTraffic) validation hook
  ##############################################################################
  PostTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-post-traffic-hook'
      Description: AfterAllowTraffic validation hook invoked by CodeDeploy after traffic has been shifted.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: !Ref LambdaLogLevel
          HOOK_STAGE: after-allow-traffic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          LOG_LEVEL = os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO').upper()
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(LOG_LEVEL)

          codedeploy = boto3.client('codedeploy')


          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event['DeploymentId']
              hook_execution_id = event['LifecycleEventHookExecutionId']

              logger.info(json.dumps({
                  'stage': os.environ.get('HOOK_STAGE'),
                  'deploymentId': deployment_id,
                  'lifecycleEventHookExecutionId': hook_execution_id,
              }))

              status = 'Succeeded'
              try:
                  # Perform post-traffic validation here (for example, exercise the
                  # live alias after the traffic shift and assert on the response).
                  logger.info('Post-traffic validation passed.')
              except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                  logger.error('Post-traffic validation failed: %s', exc)
                  status = 'Failed'

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status,
              )

              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'status': status})}
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the CodeDeploy service
  ##############################################################################
  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-codedeploy-role'
      Description: Service role that allows CodeDeploy to manage Lambda versions, aliases and traffic shifting.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCodeDeployServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeValidationHookFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeHookFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # CodeDeploy application (Lambda compute platform)
  ##############################################################################
  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-app'
      ComputePlatform: Lambda
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ##############################################################################
  # CodeDeploy deployment group with canary traffic shifting.
  # NOTE: the alias and the validation hooks are bound at deployment time by the
  # AppSpec (Resources.<function>.Properties and Hooks.BeforeAllowTraffic /
  # Hooks.AfterAllowTraffic), which references the alias name, the function name
  # and the hook function names exposed in the Outputs section below.
  ##############################################################################
  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-dg'
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
      DeploymentStyle:
        DeploymentType: BLUE_GREEN
        DeploymentOption: WITH_TRAFFIC_CONTROL
      AutoRollbackConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        Events:
          - DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

Outputs:
  MainFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the main Lambda function (AppSpec Resources.<function>.Properties.Name).
    Value: !Ref MainFunction

  MainFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the main Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Description: Published immutable version of the main Lambda function (AppSpec CurrentVersion/TargetVersion).
    Value: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version

  MainFunctionAliasName:
    Description: Name of the live alias used as the CodeDeploy traffic shifting target (AppSpec Resources.<function>.Properties.Alias).
    Value: !Select [7, !Split [':', !Ref LiveAlias]]

  MainFunctionAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the live alias used as the CodeDeploy traffic shifting target.
    Value: !Ref LiveAlias

  PreTrafficHookFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook function (AppSpec Hooks.BeforeAllowTraffic).
    Value: !Ref PreTrafficHookFunction

  PreTrafficHookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the BeforeAllowTraffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt PreTrafficHookFunction.Arn

  PostTrafficHookFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the AfterAllowTraffic validation hook function (AppSpec Hooks.AfterAllowTraffic).
    Value: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction

  PostTrafficHookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the AfterAllowTraffic validation hook function.
    Value: !GetAtt PostTrafficHookFunction.Arn

  CodeDeployApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the CodeDeploy application (Lambda compute platform).
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployApplication

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CodeDeploy deployment group performing blue-green traffic shifting.
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployDeploymentGroup

  CodeDeployServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by CodeDeploy.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PetShopAPI - Simple AppSync GraphQL API backed by a Lambda function returning a static list of pets (test/demo stack).

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PetShopAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: PetShopAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PetShopAPI

  PetShopApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      Description: API key for anonymous access to PetShopAPI

  PetShopSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Pet {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          type: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getPets: [Pet]
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda datasource function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PetShopAPI-LambdaExecutionRole

  PetListFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: PetShopAPI-GetPets
      Description: Returns a static list of pets for the PetShopAPI GraphQL API.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              pets = [
                  {"id": "1", "name": "Buddy", "type": "Dog"},
                  {"id": "2", "name": "Mittens", "type": "Cat"},
                  {"id": "3", "name": "Charlie", "type": "Bird"},
              ]
              return pets

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role that AppSync assumes to invoke the Lambda function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokePetListFunction
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PetListFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PetShopAPI-AppSyncLambdaRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync data source and resolver
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PetDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      Name: PetListDataSource
      Description: Lambda data source for the getPets query
      Type: AWS_LAMBDA
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLambdaRole.Arn
      LambdaConfig:
        LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt PetListFunction.Arn

  GetPetsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getPets
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt PetDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": {
            "operation": "getPets"
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)

    Value: !GetAtt PetShopApiKey.ApiKey

  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: Identifier of the PetShopAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt PetShopAPI.ApiId
