final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the PCI remediation automation assume role (pciautomationassumerole<region>) and four AWS Systems
  Manager Automation documents that are used by AWS Config Conformance Pack remediation actions to restrict a
  VPC default security group, delete unused security groups, release unassociated Elastic IP addresses and
  update an Auto Scaling group health check type to ELB.

Resources:

  PciAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
      Description: !Sub 'Role assumed by SSM Automation, Amazon EC2 and Amazon EventBridge to run PCI remediation actions in ${AWS::Region}.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmEc2AndEventsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pciautomationassumerole-inline-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RemediateSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
              - Sid: ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpAddresses
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AutoScalingHealthCheckRemediation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: '*'

  PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: pci-restrict-default-security-group
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Revokes every ingress and egress rule from the default security group of the specified VPC.'
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
            description: 'The ARN of the pciautomationassumerole<region> role that Automation assumes to run these steps.'
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC whose default security group will be restricted.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: getDefaultSecurityGroup
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              Filters:
                - Name: group-name
                  Values:
                    - 'default'
                - Name: vpc-id
                  Values:
                    - '{{ VpcId }}'
              AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: GroupId
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].GroupId'
                Type: String
              - Name: IngressRules
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions'
                Type: MapList
              - Name: EgressRules
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress'
                Type: MapList
            nextStep: revokeIngressRules
          - name: revokeIngressRules
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: '{{ getDefaultSecurityGroup.GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ getDefaultSecurityGroup.IngressRules }}'
              AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            nextStep: revokeEgressRules
          - name: revokeEgressRules
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: '{{ getDefaultSecurityGroup.GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ getDefaultSecurityGroup.EgressRules }}'
              AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            isEnd: true

  PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: pci-delete-unused-security-groups
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes security groups that have no ingress or egress rules and that are not associated with any
          network interface, skipping the default security group of every VPC and any group that was already deleted.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
            description: 'The ARN of the pciautomationassumerole<region> role that Automation assumes to run these steps.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: delete_unused_security_groups
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def delete_unused_security_groups(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    deleted = []
                    skipped = []
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_security_groups')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for group in page.get('SecurityGroups', []):
                            group_id = group['GroupId']
                            group_name = group.get('GroupName', '')
                            if group_name == 'default':
                                skipped.append(group_id)
                                continue
                            if group.get('IpPermissions') or group.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                                skipped.append(group_id)
                                continue
                            if group.get('NetworkInterfaces'):
                                skipped.append(group_id)
                                continue
                            try:
                                ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                                deleted.append(group_id)
                            except ClientError as error:
                                error_code = error.response['Error']['Code']
                                if error_code in ('InvalidGroup.NotFound', 'InvalidGroupId.NotFound'):
                                    skipped.append(group_id)
                                else:
                                    skipped.append(group_id)
                    return {
                        'DeletedSecurityGroups': deleted,
                        'SkippedSecurityGroups': skipped
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: DeletedSecurityGroups
                Selector: '$.Payload.DeletedSecurityGroups'
                Type: StringList
              - Name: SkippedSecurityGroups
                Selector: '$.Payload.SkippedSecurityGroups'
                Type: StringList
            isEnd: true

  PciReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: pci-release-unassociated-elastic-ips
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses by the allocation IDs supplied to the automation.'
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
            description: 'The ARN of the pciautomationassumerole<region> role that Automation assumes to run these steps.'
          AllocationIds:
            type: StringList
            description: 'Comma-separated list of the allocation IDs of the unassociated Elastic IP addresses to release.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseElasticIps
            action: 'aws:loop'
            inputs:
              Iterator:
                Items: '{{ AllocationIds }}'
              Steps:
                - name: releaseElasticIp
                  action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
                  inputs:
                    Service: ec2
                    Api: ReleaseAddress
                    AllocationId: '{{ releaseElasticIps.CurrentItem }}'
                    AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            isEnd: true

  PciUpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: pci-update-asg-health-check
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Updates an Auto Scaling group to use ELB health checks with a health check grace period of 300 seconds.'
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
            description: 'The ARN of the pciautomationassumerole<region> role that Automation assumes to run these steps.'
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'The name of the Auto Scaling group whose health check type will be set to ELB.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: describeAutoScalingGroup
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              AutoScalingGroupNames:
                - '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: AutoScalingGroupName
                Selector: '$.AutoScalingGroups[0].AutoScalingGroupName'
                Type: String
            nextStep: updateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
          - name: updateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ describeAutoScalingGroup.AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              HealthCheckType: ELB
              HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
              AssumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            isEnd: true

Outputs:
  PciAutomationAssumeRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role assumed by the PCI remediation SSM Automation documents.'
    Value: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
  PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the SSM Automation document that revokes all ingress and egress rules from a VPC default security group.'
    Value: !Ref PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument
  PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the SSM Automation document that deletes unused security groups.'
    Value: !Ref PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument
  PciReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the SSM Automation document that releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses by allocation ID.'
    Value: !Ref PciReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument
  PciUpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocumentName:
    Description: 'Name of the SSM Automation document that sets an Auto Scaling group health check type to ELB with a 300 second grace period.'
    Value: !Ref PciUpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-5969e90e' on localstack", 'iac-god-eval-5969e90e: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'PciAutomationAssumeRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'PciAutomationAssumeRole: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A']
deploy_completed_resources: PciAutomationAssumeRole

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Ear Hustle production DNS. Provisions a Route 53 public hosted zone for a parameterized apex domain
  (default earhustlesq.com) plus the complete set of production DNS records for the Ear Hustle
  application: SPF, Google site verification, Zoom verification, DMARC and ATProto TXT records;
  Google Workspace (G Suite) MX records on the apex and the legacy 'old' subdomain; Squarespace apex
  A records and www/Squarespace-verification CNAMEs; Zendesk, Campaign Monitor, Google Workspace and
  Supercast DKIM records; podcast feed and Supercast return-path CNAMEs; and an ACM DNS-validated
  certificate for the feeds subdomain whose validation record is created and managed by ACM itself.

# NOTE (objective 35): This template is declarative only. Once the stack creates the hosted zone, the
# name servers returned by the NameServers output must be delegated at the domain registrar before any
# record in this template resolves publicly. There is no drift-correcting automation here - subsequent
# manual DNS edits are outside the scope of this template and are not reverted by it.

Parameters:

  # The only infrastructure-adjacent parameter: it has a safe, non-account-specific default.
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*\.[a-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase DNS domain name such as earhustlesq.com.
    Description: Apex domain for the public hosted zone and for every record created by this template.

  SpfRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:cmail1.com include:spf.supercast.com ~all'
    Description: >-
      Apex SPF policy. Covers every sending source (Google Workspace, Campaign Monitor, Supercast /
      return-path). This is the single SPF record at the apex - do not add a second SPF TXT record at
      the same owner name.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: Token issued by Google Search Console for the google-site-verification TXT record.

  ZoomVerificationRecordName:
    Type: String
    Default: zoom_verify_REPLACE_ME
    Description: >-
      Host label (relative to the apex) of the TXT record Zoom issues for domain verification, in
      Zoom's zoom_verify_* format.

  ZoomVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: Value of the Zoom domain verification TXT record.

  DmarcRuaAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'mailto:dmarc-reports@earhustlesq.com'
    Description: Aggregate report (rua) address used in the _dmarc TXT record.

  DmarcRufAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'mailto:dmarc-forensics@earhustlesq.com'
    Description: Forensic report (ruf) address used in the _dmarc TXT record.

  AtProtoDid:
    Type: String
    Default: 'did:plc:REPLACE_ME'
    Description: ATProto DID (or handle) published at _atproto for the apex domain.

  GoogleDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: >-
      Public key Google Workspace issues for the 'google' DKIM selector. Paste the key material only,
      without the v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p= prefix and without surrounding quotes. Split keys longer than 255
      characters into additional quoted strings in the same ResourceRecords list at deploy time.

  ZendeskVerificationLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk-verification
    Description: Host label of the Zendesk-issued domain verification TXT record.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: Token issued by Zendesk for the domain verification TXT record.

  ZendeskDkim1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk1.domainkey.zendesk.com
    Description: Zendesk DKIM target host for the zendesk1._domainkey CNAME record.

  ZendeskDkim2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk2.domainkey.zendesk.com
    Description: Zendesk DKIM target host for the zendesk2._domainkey CNAME record.

  ZendeskHostnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: hostmapping.zendesk.com
    Description: Zendesk host-mapping / domain validation target host (a *.zendesk.com hostname).

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: Public key Campaign Monitor issues for the 'cm' DKIM selector (key material only).

  CampaignMonitorSpfValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:cmail1.com ~all'
    Description: >-
      SPF alignment policy for Campaign Monitor's dedicated sending subdomain. Kept off the apex so it
      never conflicts with the apex SPF record.

  CampaignMonitorMxHost:
    Type: String
    Default: mx.cmail1.com
    Description: Mail exchanger for Campaign Monitor's dedicated sending subdomain.

  CampaignMonitorReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail1.com
    Description: Campaign Monitor custom return-path (bounce) host.

  SupercastDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: supercast
    Description: DKIM selector Supercast issues for the podcast feed domain.

  SupercastDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_ME
    Description: Public key Supercast issues for its DKIM selector (key material only).

  SupercastFeedTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.supercast.com
    Description: Supercast host that serves the podcast feed for the feeds/feed subdomains.

  SupercastReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: bounces.supercast.com
    Description: Supercast bounce / return-path host.

  SquarespaceVerificationLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: verify
    Description: Host label used for the Squarespace domain-verification CNAME record.

  SquarespaceVerificationTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: verify.squarespace.com
    Description: Squarespace domain-verification target host.

Mappings:

  # Canonical Squarespace apex IPv4 addresses, kept out of the resource body (objective 19).
  Squarespace:
    Apex:
      IPv4Addresses:
        - '198.185.159.144'
        - '198.185.159.145'
        - '198.49.23.144'
        - '198.49.23.145'

Resources:

  # Public hosted zone for the Ear Hustle apex domain. Retained on stack deletion / replacement so the
  # production DNS configuration is never destroyed by lifecycle operations.
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Ear Hustle production public hosted zone for ${DomainName}'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Application
          Value: 'Ear Hustle'
        - Key: 'prx:ops:environment'
          Value: Production
        - Key: 'prx:dev:application'
          Value: 'Ear Hustle'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex TXT records: Route 53 allows exactly one TXT record set per owner name, so the SPF policy
  # and the Google site-verification token share the apex TXT record set.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfRecordValue}"'
        - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  # Zoom domain verification TXT record, published at Zoom's zoom_verify_* host label.
  ZoomVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZoomVerificationRecordName}.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZoomVerificationToken}"'

  # DMARC policy with reporting addresses and alignment settings.
  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=${DmarcRuaAddress}; ruf=${DmarcRufAddress}; aspf=r; adkim=r; pct=100"'

  # ATProto (Bluesky) handle verification record.
  AtProtoTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_atproto.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"did=${AtProtoDid}"'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace (G Suite) mail routing: apex plus the deprecated legacy subdomain.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'

  LegacySubdomainMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'old.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Squarespace web hosting.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords: !FindInMap [Squarespace, Apex, IPv4Addresses]

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'ext-sq.squarespace.com'

  SquarespaceVerificationCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SquarespaceVerificationLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceVerificationTarget

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Podcast feeds served by Supercast. CNAME only at these owner names - no A or TXT record is
  # created at feeds.<domain> or feed.<domain>, so there is no type conflict.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FeedsCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastFeedTarget

  LegacyFeedCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feed.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastFeedTarget

  SupercastDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SupercastDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${SupercastDkimPublicKey}"'

  SupercastReturnPathCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'rp.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastReturnPathTarget

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Zendesk: domain verification TXT record, DKIM CNAMEs and host-mapping CNAME. The verification TXT
  # is used instead of a CNAME at the same owner name so the two record types never collide.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskVerificationLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"zendesk-verification=${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  ZendeskDkim1CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkim1Target

  ZendeskDkim2CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkim2Target

  ZendeskHostnameCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'help.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskHostnameTarget

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Campaign Monitor: DKIM, SPF alignment, return-path and dedicated sending subdomain MX.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignMonitorDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorSpfTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cmail1.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorSpfValue}"'

  CampaignMonitorMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cmail1.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '10 ${CampaignMonitorMxHost}'

  CampaignMonitorReturnPathCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cmail.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorReturnPathTarget

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace DKIM (google selector).
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleDkimPublicKey}"'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain. The certificate is created in the stack's deployment
  # region; deploy the stack in us-east-1 if the certificate is later attached to CloudFront.
  #
  # The DNS validation record for this certificate is created and managed by ACM, not by this
  # template: setting DomainValidationOptions[0].HostedZoneId to the hosted zone defined above
  # authorizes ACM to write the validation CNAME (whose name and value are generated per-domain by
  # ACM and are not exposed as a CloudFormation GetAtt attribute) directly into that zone.
  #
  # There is intentionally NO companion AWS::Route53::RecordSet for the validation record here.
  # Do not re-add one: the validation name/target cannot be obtained from the certificate resource
  # schema and must not be hardcoded or invented.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FeedsCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

Outputs:

  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route 53 public hosted zone ID for the Ear Hustle production domain.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone

  ApexDomainName:
    Description: Apex domain served by the hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref DomainName

  NameServers:
    Description: >-
      Authoritative name servers for the hosted zone. These values must be delegated at the domain
      registrar before any record created by this template will resolve publicly.
    Value: !Join [', ', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

  FeedsCertificateArn:
    Description: ARN of the ACM DNS-validated certificate for the feeds subdomain.
    Value: !Ref FeedsCertificate

  FeedsValidationRecordOwner:
    Description: >-
      The ACM certificate performs DNS validation automatically by writing its validation CNAME into
      the hosted zone identified by HostedZoneId (see the certificate's DomainValidationOptions).
      This output names the host that is validated, so ops can confirm validation without needing to
      read an attribute the certificate resource does not publish.
    Value: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'

  EnvironmentTag:
    Description: Deployment environment applied to the hosted zone tags.
    Value: Production

  ApplicationTag:
    Description: Application name applied to the hosted zone tags.
    Value: 'Ear Hustle'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard portal platform. Creates a
  customer-managed KMS key, an Amazon ECR repository, App Runner ECR access
  (build) role, App Runner instance (task) role with Directory Service and
  QuickSight provisioning permissions, a Secrets Manager secret for the
  QuickSight admin credential, and an AWS App Runner service with
  auto-deployments and an HTTP health check at /status on port 8080.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application
        Parameters:
          - ApplicationName
          - Environment
          - ImageTag
      - Label:
          default: QuickSight Tenant Provisioning
        Parameters:
          - AdminUserName
          - AdminEmail
          - QuickSightTemplateId
          - QuickSightDataSetId
          - QuickSightDataSourceId
          - QuickSightDatabaseName
          - QuickSightTableName
          - QuickSightFilterColumnName
    ParameterLabels:
      ApplicationName:
        default: Application name
      Environment:
        default: Environment
      ImageTag:
        default: Container image tag
      AdminUserName:
        default: QuickSight admin user name
      AdminEmail:
        default: QuickSight admin email placeholder
      QuickSightTemplateId:
        default: QuickSight template identifier
      QuickSightDataSetId:
        default: QuickSight dataset identifier
      QuickSightDataSourceId:
        default: QuickSight datasource identifier
      QuickSightDatabaseName:
        default: QuickSight database name
      QuickSightTableName:
        default: QuickSight table name
      QuickSightFilterColumnName:
        default: QuickSight tenant filter column

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: qsportal
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits
      and hyphens, and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
    Description: Short lowercase application name used to build resource names.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used to build resource names.

  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: latest
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,127}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid container image tag (letters, digits, underscores, periods
      and hyphens).
    Description: >-
      Container image tag deployed by App Runner. Because the repository uses
      IMMUTABLE tags, each CI/CD release must push a unique tag value; set this
      parameter to the tag produced by the pipeline for the release being deployed.

  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: QuickSight administrative user name used for tenant provisioning.

  AdminEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 254
    Description: >-
      Non-sensitive placeholder administrative e-mail address supplied to the
      application at runtime.

  QuickSightTemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-dashboard-template
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: QuickSight template identifier used when provisioning tenant dashboards.

  QuickSightDataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-dashboard-dataset
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: QuickSight dataset identifier used when provisioning tenant dashboards.

  QuickSightDataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-analytics-datasource
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: QuickSight data source identifier used when provisioning tenant dashboards.

  QuickSightDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: analytics
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Database name for the QuickSight tenant analytics data source.

  QuickSightTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_metrics
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Table name for the QuickSight tenant analytics dataset.

  QuickSightFilterColumnName:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_id
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Column used to enforce row-level tenant filtering in QuickSight.

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals
    - !Ref Environment
    - prod

Resources:

  ApplicationKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} QuickSight portal data at rest'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEcrUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecr.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ApplicationKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ApplicationKmsKey

  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-quicksight'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !GetAtt ApplicationKmsKey.Arn
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images after 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  QuickSightAdminSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApplicationName}/${Environment}/quicksight/admin-credentials'
      Description: >-
        QuickSight administrative credential consumed by the App Runner service at runtime.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ApplicationKmsKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username":"${AdminUserName}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppRunnerEcrAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner-ecr-access'
      Description: App Runner build role used to pull images from the application ECR repository.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerBuildService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner-ecr-access-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrGetAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrImagePullFromApplicationRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !GetAtt EcrRepository.Arn
              - Sid: DecryptImagesFromApplicationRepository
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ApplicationKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppRunnerInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-apprunner-instance'
      Description: >-
        App Runner instance role granting tenant provisioning access to AWS Directory
        Service and Amazon QuickSight, plus read access to the admin credential secret.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerTasksService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-directory-service-provisioning'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceCreate
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
                  - ds:CreateTrust
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceDescribeAndAuthorize
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:DescribeDomainControllers
                  - ds:AuthorizeApplication
                  - ds:UnauthorizeApplication
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:directory/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-quicksight-provisioning'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightNamespaceManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightDataSourceManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightDataSetManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSet
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightContentManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:CreateDashboard
                  - quicksight:CreateTheme
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightUserAndGroupManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:UpdateUser
                  - quicksight:CreateGroup
                  - quicksight:CreateGroupMembership
                  - quicksight:DescribeGroup
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:TagResource
                  - quicksight:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-quicksight-admin-secret-read'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadQuickSightAdminSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref QuickSightAdminSecret
              - Sid: DecryptQuickSightAdminSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ApplicationKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-qs-portal'
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerEcrAccessRole.Arn
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${EcrRepository.RepositoryUri}:${ImageTag}'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: '0.0.0.0/0'
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: !Ref AdminEmail
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSetId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATABASE_NAME
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDatabaseName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_TABLE_NAME
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTableName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_FILTER_COLUMN_NAME
                Value: !Ref QuickSightFilterColumnName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_ADMIN_SECRET_ARN
                Value: !Ref QuickSightAdminSecret
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1024'
        Memory: '2048'
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerInstanceRole.Arn
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /status
        Interval: 10
        Timeout: 5
        HealthyThreshold: 1
        UnhealthyThreshold: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ImageUri:
    Description: >-
      Full ECR image URI that the CI/CD pipeline must push to. Because repository
      tags are IMMUTABLE, each release must build and push a unique image tag and
      supply it through the ImageTag parameter.
    Value: !Sub '${EcrRepository.RepositoryUri}:${ImageTag}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageUri'

  EcrRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository created by this stack.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcrRepositoryUri'

  EcrRepositoryName:
    Description: Name of the ECR repository created by this stack.
    Value: !Ref EcrRepository
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcrRepositoryName'

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting the repository and secret.
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'

  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key protecting the repository and secret.
    Value: !Ref ApplicationKmsKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAliasName'

  ServiceUrl:
    Description: Public HTTPS URL of the App Runner QuickSight portal service.
    Value: !GetAtt AppRunnerService.ServiceUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ServiceUrl'

  ServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the App Runner QuickSight portal service.
    Value: !GetAtt AppRunnerService.ServiceArn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture in alignment with the CIS AWS Foundations
  Benchmark control for VPC flow logging. The stack creates a customer-managed KMS key and a
  CloudWatch Logs log group (encrypted with that key) that receives the flow log records, an IAM
  role that the VPC Flow Logs delivery service assumes to publish to that log group, a Systems
  Manager Automation execution role, an SSM Automation document that enables flow logs directly on
  a VPC, and a second SSM Automation document that routes the same remediation through AWS Systems
  Manager Change Manager for change approval.

Parameters:

  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: >-
      Number of days that VPC Flow Log records are retained in the CloudWatch Logs log group.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value applied to every resource created by this template.

  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: CloudPlatformTeam
    Description: Owner tag value applied to every resource created by this template.

  CisControl:
    Type: String
    Default: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Benchmark-3.9
    Description: CIS control tag value applied to every resource created by this template.

Resources:

  VpcFlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministrationOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-delivery"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs delivery service to publish flow log records to the
        CloudWatch Logs log group created by this template.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishVpcFlowLogsToLogGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogRecordsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ssm-automation-execution"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation and Change Manager to run the VPC flow log
        remediation steps and to submit the associated change request.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsRemediation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageFlowLogsLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsDeliveryRoleToEc2FlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
        - PolicyName: SystemsManagerChangeManager
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAndInspectFlowLogRemediationAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${VpcFlowLogsRejectDocument}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*"
              - Sid: ManageFlowLogChangeRequests
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

  VpcFlowLogsRejectDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EnableVpcFlowLogsReject"
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture for a single VPC by calling the Amazon
          EC2 CreateFlowLogs API from a Python (boto3) script. Aligned with the CIS AWS Foundations
          Benchmark control for VPC flow logging.
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps.
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC on which VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture are enabled.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
            description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log records.
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: ARN of the IAM role that the flow log service uses to publish to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableFlowLogsReject
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Creates a CloudWatch Logs VPC flow log with REJECT traffic capture for the target VPC.
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: "python3.12"
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: "{{VpcId}}"
                LogGroupName: "{{LogGroupName}}"
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: "{{DeliverLogsPermissionArn}}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
                    vpc_id = events["VpcId"]
                    log_group_name = events["LogGroupName"]
                    deliver_logs_permission_arn = events["DeliverLogsPermissionArn"]

                    # Fail fast when the VPC does not exist in this account and Region.
                    vpcs = ec2.describe_vpcs(VpcIds=[vpc_id]).get("Vpcs", [])
                    if not vpcs:
                        raise ValueError("VPC {} was not found".format(vpc_id))

                    # Idempotency: reuse an existing REJECT flow log that already delivers to the target log group.
                    existing_flow_logs = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpc_id]},
                            {"Name": "traffic-type", "Values": ["REJECT"]},
                        ]
                    ).get("FlowLogs", [])
                    for flow_log in existing_flow_logs:
                        if (
                            flow_log.get("LogGroupName") == log_group_name
                            and flow_log.get("FlowLogStatus") == "ACTIVE"
                        ):
                            return {
                                "FlowLogId": flow_log.get("FlowLogId", ""),
                                "VpcId": vpc_id,
                                "LogGroupName": log_group_name,
                                "FlowLogStatus": "ALREADY_ENABLED",
                            }

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType="VPC",
                        TrafficType="REJECT",
                        LogDestinationType="cloud-watch-logs",
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=deliver_logs_permission_arn,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                "ResourceType": "vpc-flow-log",
                                "Tags": [
                                    {"Key": "Name", "Value": "vpc-flow-logs-reject"},
                                    {"Key": "CIS-Control", "Value": "3.9"},
                                ],
                            }
                        ],
                    )

                    flow_log_ids = response.get("FlowLogIds", [])
                    if not flow_log_ids:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "CreateFlowLogs returned no flow log ID: {}".format(
                                response.get("Unsuccessful", [])
                            )
                        )

                    return {
                        "FlowLogId": flow_log_ids[0],
                        "VpcId": vpc_id,
                        "LogGroupName": log_group_name,
                        "FlowLogStatus": "CREATED",
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogId
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogId
                Type: String
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: $.Payload.VpcId
                Type: String
              - Name: LogGroupName
                Selector: $.Payload.LogGroupName
                Type: String
              - Name: FlowLogStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogStatus
                Type: String
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

  VpcFlowLogsRejectChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EnableVpcFlowLogsRejectViaChangeManager"
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: >-
          Routes the VPC Flow Log REJECT traffic capture remediation through AWS Systems Manager
          Change Manager as a formal change request and runs the EnableVpcFlowLogsReject automation
          document once the change is approved. Aligned with the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
          control for VPC flow logging.
        assumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run the steps and the remediation runbook.
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC on which VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture are enabled.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
            description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log records.
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: ARN of the IAM role that the flow log service uses to publish to CloudWatch Logs.
          ChangeRequestName:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) Name of the Change Manager change request. A unique name is generated when empty.
          Requester:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) Identity requesting the change, recorded in the change request details.
          Approvers:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) Approvers recorded in the change request details for audit purposes.
          ChangeDetails:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) Additional context stored with the change request.
          ScheduledTime:
            type: String
            default: ""
            description: (Optional) ISO-8601 UTC time at which the approved change may run. Defaults to now plus LeadTimeMinutes.
          LeadTimeMinutes:
            type: Integer
            default: 30
            description: Minutes from now used to compute the scheduled time when ScheduledTime is empty.
          AutoApprove:
            type: String
            default: "false"
            allowedValues:
              - "false"
              - "true"
            description: Set to true to let Change Manager run the remediation without a manual approval.
        mainSteps:
          - name: StartFlowLogRemediationChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Starts a Change Manager change request that runs the EnableVpcFlowLogsReject document after approval.
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: "python3.12"
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: "{{VpcId}}"
                LogGroupName: "{{LogGroupName}}"
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: "{{DeliverLogsPermissionArn}}"
                RemediationDocumentName: !Ref VpcFlowLogsRejectDocument
                AutomationAssumeRole: "{{AutomationAssumeRole}}"
                ChangeRequestName: "{{ChangeRequestName}}"
                Requester: "{{Requester}}"
                Approvers: "{{Approvers}}"
                ChangeDetails: "{{ChangeDetails}}"
                ScheduledTime: "{{ScheduledTime}}"
                LeadTimeMinutes: "{{LeadTimeMinutes}}"
                AutoApprove: "{{AutoApprove}}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone


                def handler(events, context):
                    ssm = boto3.client("ssm")

                    vpc_id = events["VpcId"]
                    log_group_name = events["LogGroupName"]
                    deliver_logs_permission_arn = events["DeliverLogsPermissionArn"]
                    remediation_document_name = events["RemediationDocumentName"]
                    automation_assume_role = events["AutomationAssumeRole"]
                    requester = events.get("Requester") or "not specified"
                    approvers = events.get("Approvers") or "not specified"
                    auto_approve = str(events.get("AutoApprove", "false")).lower() == "true"

                    change_request_name = events.get("ChangeRequestName") or "EnableVpcFlowLogsReject-{}-{}".format(
                        vpc_id, datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
                    )

                    scheduled_time = events.get("ScheduledTime") or ""
                    if scheduled_time:
                        scheduled_time = datetime.fromisoformat(scheduled_time.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                    else:
                        lead_time_minutes = int(events.get("LeadTimeMinutes") or 30)
                        scheduled_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=lead_time_minutes)

                    change_details = events.get("ChangeDetails") or (
                        "Enable VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on {} "
                        "(CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control for VPC flow logging). "
                        "Requester: {}. Approvers: {}.".format(vpc_id, requester, approvers)
                    )

                    response = ssm.start_change_request_execution(
                        ChangeRequestName=change_request_name,
                        ChangeDetails=change_details,
                        AutoApprove=auto_approve,
                        ScheduledTime=scheduled_time,
                        Runbooks=[
                            {
                                "DocumentName": remediation_document_name,
                                "Parameters": {
                                    "VpcId": [vpc_id],
                                    "LogGroupName": [log_group_name],
                                    "DeliverLogsPermissionArn": [deliver_logs_permission_arn],
                                    "AutomationAssumeRole": [automation_assume_role],
                                },
                            }
                        ],
                    )

                    return {
                        "ChangeRequestExecutionId": response.get("AutomationExecutionId", ""),
                        "ChangeRequestName": change_request_name,
                        "VpcId": vpc_id,
                        "ScheduledTime": scheduled_time.isoformat(),
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ChangeRequestExecutionId
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeRequestExecutionId
                Type: String
              - Name: ChangeRequestName
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeRequestName
                Type: String
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: $.Payload.VpcId
                Type: String
              - Name: ScheduledTime
                Selector: $.Payload.ScheduledTime
                Type: String
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
        - Key: CIS-Control
          Value: !Ref CisControl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API built with Amazon API Gateway (WebSocket protocol).
  Every inbound frame hits the $default route, which asynchronously starts a
  Standard AWS Step Functions state machine and immediately acknowledges the
  client. The state machine waits five seconds and then pushes a reply back to
  the originating WebSocket connection through the API Gateway Management API.
  Access logs are encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key created in this
  template.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-128 characters and may contain only letters, numbers, hyphens
      and underscores.
    Description: >-
      Name of the WebSocket API deployment stage. It is also used to build the
      reply endpoint that is passed to the state machine.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # Access log encryption key
  ##########################################################################

  AccessLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${AWS::StackName} WebSocket API access logs.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableKeyAdministrationViaIam
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  ##########################################################################
  # WebSocket API
  ##########################################################################

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      Description: >-
        WebSocket API that hands every inbound frame to a Step Functions
        workflow through the $default route.
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------- $connect

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: '{"statusCode": 200}'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------- $disconnect

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: '{"statusCode": 200}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- $default

  StartExecutionIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {"StateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}", "Input": "{\"connectionId\": "$context.connectionId", \"domainName\": "$context.domainName", \"stage\": "$context.stage", \"endpoint\": "https://$context.domainName/${StageName}", \"message\": "$util.base64Encode($input.body)"}"}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${StartExecutionIntegration}'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------- Stage

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}/websocket-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AccessLogsKey.Arn

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: Deployment stage for the WebSocket API.
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","eventType":"$context.eventType","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","sourceIp":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","messageId":"$context.messageId"}'

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM
  ##########################################################################

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Lets API Gateway start this stack's Step Functions state machine on
        behalf of the WebSocket $default route.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartWebSocketStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartExecutionOfWebSocketWorkflow
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Lets the Step Functions state machine post replies back to the
        originating WebSocket connection.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostToWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageConnections
                Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'

  ##########################################################################
  # Step Functions workflow
  ##########################################################################

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Wait five seconds, then reply to the originating WebSocket connection.",
          "StartAt": "InitializeConnection",
          "States": {
            "InitializeConnection": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Parameters": {
                "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                "endpoint.$": "$.endpoint",
                "message.$": "$.message"
              },
              "Next": "WaitFiveSeconds"
            },
            "WaitFiveSeconds": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "PostToConnection"
            },
            "PostToConnection": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:apigatewaymanagementapi:postToConnection",
              "Parameters": {
                "ApiEndpoint.$": "$.endpoint",
                "ConnectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                "Data.$": "$.message"
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

    Value: !Ref StateMachine
