final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hourly AWS Organizations account-closure workflow. An Amazon EventBridge rule invokes an EXPRESS
  Step Functions state machine that paginates every account in the organization, closes the ACTIVE
  accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, acknowledges closure by overwriting that
  same tag to ACKNOWLEDGED, and records every execution in a customer-managed-KMS-encrypted
  CloudWatch Logs group retained for 365 days. Every dependency is created by this template
  (greenfield deployment).

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Cosmetic environment label applied as a tag to the resources in this template. It does not
      change workflow behavior and has a safe default so the stack deploys with no operator input.
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key that encrypts the execution log group.
  # Created here because this is a greenfield account: the key ARN is never
  # parameterized, resolved from an external secret, or hardcoded.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExecutionLogGroupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    # Key material must survive stack replacement/deletion of the log group.
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        CMK used to encrypt the Step Functions account-closure execution log group. CloudWatch Logs
        encrypts/decrypts log data with this key on behalf of the workflow.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      # Standard key-administration stanza scoped to the deploying account root, plus the minimum
      # grant CloudWatch Logs needs to actually encrypt this log group. The service-principal
      # statement is constrained with an encryption-context condition so the key cannot be used to
      # read or write any other log group. The encryption-context ARN is derived from
      # ${AWS::StackName} (not from the log group resource) so the key never references the log
      # group - this keeps the dependency graph acyclic.
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministrationOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKeyForThisLogGroupOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AWS::StackName}-account-closure'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution log group (365-day retention, CMK-encrypted, retained across
  # stack operations)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExecutionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    # Execution history must survive stack replacements/deletions.
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      # The /aws/vendedlogs/ prefix is required for Step Functions (and EventBridge) log delivery.
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      # AWS-0017 / AVD-AWS-0017: log groups must be encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ExecutionLogGroupKey.Arn
      # NOTE: No AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy is created. For log groups living under the
      # /aws/vendedlogs/ prefix in the same account and Region, Step Functions manages log delivery
      # itself and no explicit log-group resource policy is required. Add an AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
      # only if this log group is ever moved to another account.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure-execution-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Least-privilege execution role for the state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure-sfn'
      Description: >-
        Least-privilege execution role for the hourly Organizations account-closure EXPRESS state
        machine (Organizations account lifecycle actions plus CloudWatch Logs delivery only).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosure
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # The Organizations API does not support resource-level ARN restriction for these
              # operations, so Resource must be '*'. The effective blast radius is nevertheless
              # bounded: this policy exists only on this single-purpose role, and
              # organizations:CloseAccount can only be called from the management account of the
              # organization. organization:* and unrelated Organizations actions are deliberately
              # not granted.
              - Sid: OrganizationsAccountLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                  - organizations:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              # The CloudWatch Logs log-delivery APIs (CreateLogDelivery, GetLogDelivery,
              # UpdateLogDelivery, DeleteLogDelivery, ListLogDeliveries, PutResourcePolicy,
              # DescribeResourcePolicies, DescribeLogGroups) do not support resource-level ARNs, so
              # Resource '*' is required here. This is the minimum set of log-delivery permissions
              # required for EXPRESS workflow logging.
              - Sid: StepFunctionsVendedLogsDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ExecutionLogGroupKeyUsage
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # The CMK that encrypts the execution log group is used by this identity when the
              # workflow's log data is written, so the key must explicitly admit this role. Scoped to
              # the single key ARN created above - never '*'.
              - Sid: UseExecutionLogGroupKeyOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ExecutionLogGroupKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPRESS state machine: paginated account-closure workflow
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      # EXPRESS is used because the workflow is invoked on a high-volume hourly schedule and every
      # execution writes its data to the execution log group.
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure'
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      # X-Ray tracing is intentionally NOT enabled: the execution role is not granted
      # xray:PutTraceSegments / xray:PutTelemetryRecords, so enabling tracing would create an
      # unfunded dependency.
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              # Step Functions requires the log group ARN to end with ':*'.
              LogGroupArn: !Sub '${ExecutionLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Hourly AWS Organizations account-closure workflow. Execution logs: ${LogGroupName} (${LogGroupArn}). Management account ${AWS::AccountId}, region ${AWS::Region}. The workflow enumerates every account in the organization, closes the ACTIVE accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, then overwrites that same tag to ACKNOWLEDGED. Operational caveat: organizations:CloseAccount only SCHEDULES closure - it is not synchronous and the account moves to PENDING_CLOSURE, so accounts already in PENDING_CLOSURE or SUSPENDED are intentionally skipped and repeated hourly runs are idempotent.",
            "StartAt": "ListOrganizationAccounts",
            "States": {
              "ListOrganizationAccounts": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Comment": "First page of organization accounts. NextToken is deliberately not passed here; every subsequent page is fetched by ListOrganizationAccountsNextPage so that an undefined NextToken parameter is never sent to the Organizations API.",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
                "Parameters": {
                  "MaxResults": 20
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.Page",
                "Retry": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                      "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                      "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                      "Organizations.ServiceException"
                    ],
                    "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                    "MaxAttempts": 6,
                    "BackoffRate": 2.0
                  }
                ],
                "Catch": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "States.ALL"
                    ],
                    "Next": "RecordPageFailure"
                  }
                ],
                "Next": "ProcessAccountPage"
              },
              "ListOrganizationAccountsNextPage": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Comment": "Subsequent pages of organization accounts, using the NextToken returned by the previous page.",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
                "Parameters": {
                  "MaxResults": 20,
                  "NextToken.$": "$.Page.NextToken"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.Page",
                "Retry": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                      "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                      "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                      "Organizations.ServiceException"
                    ],
                    "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                    "MaxAttempts": 6,
                    "BackoffRate": 2.0
                  }
                ],
                "Catch": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "States.ALL"
                    ],
                    "Next": "RecordPageFailure"
                  }
                ],
                "Next": "ProcessAccountPage"
              },
              "ProcessAccountPage": {
                "Type": "Map",
                "Comment": "Inline Map (Express workflows do not support Distributed Map). Accounts are processed one at a time to stay well below the Organizations API throttling limits.",
                "ItemsPath": "$.Page.Accounts",
                "MaxConcurrency": 1,
                "ResultPath": "$.PageResults",
                "ItemProcessor": {
                  "ProcessorConfig": {
                    "Mode": "INLINE"
                  },
                  "StartAt": "ListAccountTags",
                  "States": {
                    "ListAccountTags": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Comment": "Read the tags of this account. The Organizations tagging APIs accept the account ARN as ResourceId.",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "ResourceId.$": "$.Arn"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.AccountTags",
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                            "Organizations.ServiceException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 6,
                          "BackoffRate": 2.0
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "States.ALL"
                          ],
                          "Next": "RecordAccountFailure"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "FindClosureRequestedTag"
                    },
                    "FindClosureRequestedTag": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "JSONPath filter expressions are supported in a Pass state's Parameters field; this selects only the tag whose Key is organizations:account-closure and whose Value is REQUESTED.",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "RequestedClosureTags.$": "$.AccountTags.Tags[?(@.Key == 'organizations:account-closure' && @.Value == 'REQUESTED')]"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.ClosureRequest",
                      "Next": "IsClosureRequested"
                    },
                    "IsClosureRequested": {
                      "Type": "Choice",
                      "Comment": "Only accounts whose tag set contains organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED continue. Every other account falls through to a no-op terminal so the execution keeps going without failing.",
                      "Choices": [
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.ClosureRequest.RequestedClosureTags[0]",
                          "IsPresent": true,
                          "Next": "InitializeStateRecheck"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Default": "SkipAccountNotTaggedForClosure"
                    },
                    "SkipAccountNotTaggedForClosure": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "No-op terminal: this account is not tagged for closure, so it is skipped without failing the execution.",
                      "End": true
                    },
                    "InitializeStateRecheck": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "Initializes the bounded eventual-consistency recheck counter used by CheckStateRecheckLimit.",
                      "Result": {
                        "Attempt": 0
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.StateRecheck",
                      "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                    },
                    "DescribeAccount": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Comment": "Read the account lifecycle state. DescribeAccount can fail or return a stale state immediately after another Organizations operation, so it is retried with backoff and the Wait state below adds an explicit settle period before the state is re-evaluated.",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.AccountDetails",
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.AccountNotReadyException",
                            "Organizations.ResourceNotFoundException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                          "MaxAttempts": 4,
                          "BackoffRate": 2.0
                        },
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                            "Organizations.ServiceException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 6,
                          "BackoffRate": 2.0
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "States.ALL"
                          ],
                          "Next": "RecordAccountFailure"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "CheckAccountLifecycleState"
                    },
                    "CheckAccountLifecycleState": {
                      "Type": "Choice",
                      "Comment": "Only ACTIVE accounts are closed. Accounts already in PENDING_CLOSURE or SUSPENDED are already being closed, so they are routed to a skip path instead of being re-closed - this is what makes the hourly schedule idempotent.",
                      "Choices": [
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.AccountDetails.Account.State",
                          "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                          "Next": "CloseAccount"
                        },
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.AccountDetails.Account.State",
                          "StringEquals": "PENDING_CLOSURE",
                          "Next": "SkipAccountAlreadyClosing"
                        },
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.AccountDetails.Account.State",
                          "StringEquals": "SUSPENDED",
                          "Next": "SkipAccountAlreadyClosing"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Default": "CheckStateRecheckLimit"
                    },
                    "SkipAccountAlreadyClosing": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "No-op terminal: the account is already being closed (PENDING_CLOSURE) or is SUSPENDED, so it is skipped rather than re-closed.",
                      "End": true
                    },
                    "CheckStateRecheckLimit": {
                      "Type": "Choice",
                      "Comment": "Caps the eventual-consistency recheck loop so an account in an unexpected state can never spin forever.",
                      "Choices": [
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.StateRecheck.Attempt",
                          "NumericGreaterThanEquals": 3,
                          "Next": "SkipAccountStateUnresolved"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Default": "IncrementStateRecheck"
                    },
                    "SkipAccountStateUnresolved": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "No-op terminal: after the bounded number of rechecks the account is still not in a state this workflow acts on (for example PENDING_ACTIVATION or CLOSED), so it is skipped and the execution continues.",
                      "End": true
                    },
                    "IncrementStateRecheck": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "Increments the recheck counter using the States.MathAdd intrinsic function.",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "Attempt.$": "States.MathAdd($.StateRecheck.Attempt, 1)"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.StateRecheck",
                      "Next": "WaitForAccountStateToSettle"
                    },
                    "WaitForAccountStateToSettle": {
                      "Type": "Wait",
                      "Comment": "Gives Organizations eventual consistency time to settle before the account state is re-evaluated.",
                      "Seconds": 30,
                      "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                    },
                    "CloseAccount": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Comment": "Schedules the account closure. This call is NOT synchronous: it returns as soon as closure has been scheduled and the account moves to PENDING_CLOSURE. Only the management account of the organization can call this API, which additionally bounds the effective scope of the permissions granted above.",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                      },
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                            "Organizations.ServiceException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 6,
                          "BackoffRate": 2.0
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "States.ALL"
                          ],
                          "Next": "RecordAccountFailure"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "AcknowledgeAccountClosure"
                    },
                    "AcknowledgeAccountClosure": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Comment": "ASSUMPTION: the request only says 'tag the account with ACKNOWLEDGED'. Because the account already carries the organizations:account-closure key (value REQUESTED), this step overwrites that SAME tag key with the value ACKNOWLEDGED rather than adding a second, differently keyed tag.",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "ResourceId.$": "$.Arn",
                        "Tags": [
                          {
                            "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                            "Value": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                            "Organizations.ServiceException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 6,
                          "BackoffRate": 2.0
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "States.ALL"
                          ],
                          "Next": "RecordAccountFailure"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "AccountProcessed"
                    },
                    "AccountProcessed": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "No-op terminal: closure has been requested and the closure marker has been acknowledged for this account.",
                      "End": true
                    },
                    "RecordAccountFailure": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Comment": "Failure-recording terminal. Every Organizations task in this Map catches States.ALL and lands here, so a single failing account is recorded in the execution log and the remaining accounts in the page are still processed instead of the whole execution aborting.",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "AccountId.$": "$.Id",
                        "AccountArn.$": "$.Arn",
                        "Error.$": "$.Error"
                      },
                      "End": true
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Next": "CheckForMoreAccountPages"
              },
              "CheckForMoreAccountPages": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Comment": "Loop back for the next page while Organizations returned a NextToken; the loop terminates when NextToken is absent.",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.Page.NextToken",
                    "IsPresent": true,
                    "Next": "ListOrganizationAccountsNextPage"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "WorkflowComplete"
              },
              "WorkflowComplete": {
                "Type": "Succeed"
              },
              "RecordPageFailure": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "Comment": "Records a page-enumeration failure in the execution log and ends this run; the next hourly invocation retries from the first page.",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Error.$": "$.Error"
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - LogGroupName: !Ref ExecutionLogGroup
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExecutionLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge invocation role (scoped to this state machine only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure-events'
      Description: >-
        Allows the hourly EventBridge rule to start executions of the account-closure state machine.
        StartExecution is scoped to that single state machine ARN - no wildcard resource.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAccountClosureStateMachineOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hourly schedule
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-closure-hourly'
      Description: >-
        Runs every hour and invokes the EXPRESS account-closure state machine, which closes ACTIVE
        organization accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachineTarget
          Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvocationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EXPRESS account-closure state machine invoked by the hourly schedule.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  ExecutionLogGroupName:
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs group (365-day retention, CMK-encrypted) that receives all
      execution log data.
    Value: !Ref ExecutionLogGroup
  ScheduleRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule that triggers the account-closure workflow every hour.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureScheduleRule
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers the account-closure workflow every hour.
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureScheduleRule.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline that produces a custom, CIS Level 1 hardened
  Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
  The template provisions its own VPC, private build networking with VPC endpoints,
  security groups, IAM instance profile/roles, a customer-managed KMS key, an
  encrypted/versioned/access-logged S3 bucket pair and encrypted VPC flow logs
  (greenfield), builds daily, enables AMI vulnerability scanning, distributes the
  AMI in-region with launch permissions shared to an AWS Organization and dummy
  dev/prod accounts, and automatically deletes images older than 6 months.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Builder Pipeline Settings
        Parameters:
          - BuildScheduleExpression
      - Label:
          default: AMI Distribution / Launch Permissions
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - DevAccountIds
          - ProdAccountIds

Parameters:
  BuildScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
    Description: >-
      Schedule expression (rate or cron) that triggers the daily Image Builder
      pipeline execution. Default runs every day at 06:00 UTC.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-abcdef1234'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations ID whose member accounts are granted launch permissions
      on the distributed AMI.

  DevAccountIds:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}(,\d{12})*$'
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated string of dummy development AWS account IDs granted launch
      permissions on the distributed AMI.

  ProdAccountIds:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}(,\d{12})*$'
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated string of dummy production AWS account IDs granted launch
      permissions on the distributed AMI.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # Networking (greenfield) - VPC, build subnet, IGW, route table, SGs
  ############################################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-subnet'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-igw'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-rt'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable

  BuildInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Image Builder build instances - no inbound rules; outbound HTTPS to the
        in-VPC service endpoints only (SSM, EC2 Messages, S3 gateway, KMS).
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.42.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC to service endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build-sg'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        VPC endpoint network interfaces - allows HTTPS only from the Image
        Builder build security group.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt BuildInstanceSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.42.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # VPC endpoints - allow SSM, EC2 messages, KMS and S3 without internet egress
  ############################################################################

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref BuildRouteTable

  ############################################################################
  # KMS - customer-managed key for build-log bucket and flow-log group
  ############################################################################

  LogBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer-managed key for Image Builder build-log bucket and VPC
        flow-log group encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # S3 - primary build-log bucket (SSE-KMS, versioned, access-logged, retained)
  ############################################################################

  ImageBuilderLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref LogBucketKmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: imagebuilder-access-logs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-logs'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ImageBuilderLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLSRequests
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ############################################################################
  # S3 - dedicated server-access-log destination bucket (AES256, retained)
  ############################################################################

  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-access-logs'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: DenyNonTLSRequests
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ############################################################################
  # IAM - build instance role/profile + Image Builder execution role
  ############################################################################

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Image Builder build instances (provisioned via SSM)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BuildLogBucketKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseLogBucketKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucketKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Least-privilege execution role assumed by the EC2 Image Builder service to
        build, scan, distribute and expire AMIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2ImageAndInstanceOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EC2SnapshotAndVolumeOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                  - ec2:EnableFastSnapshotRestores
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SSMOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:ListCommandInvocations
                  - ssm:CreateDocument
                  - ssm:DeleteDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:ListDocuments
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                  - ssm:GetPatchBaseline
                  - ssm:GetDefaultPatchBaseline
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderLogBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderLogBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucketKmsKey.Arn
              - Sid: PassImageBuilderInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt InstanceProfile.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder component - Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration
  ############################################################################

  ElasticBeanstalkPreconfigureComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: custom-eb-preconfigure
      Description: >-
        Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
        (package baseline, CloudWatch agent, /var/app conventions owned by ec2-user).
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Architecture: arm64
      Data: |
        name: custom-eb-preconfigure
        description: Pre-configure Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateOperatingSystem
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf -y update
              - name: InstallElasticBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install httpd amazon-cloudwatch-agent
                    - systemctl enable httpd || true
                    - systemctl enable amazon-cloudwatch-agent || true
              - name: ConfigureElasticBeanstalkConventions
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - getent passwd ec2-user
                    - install -d -o ec2-user -g ec2-user -m 0755 /var/app
                    - install -d -o ec2-user -g ec2-user -m 0755 /var/app/current
                    - install -d -o ec2-user -g ec2-user -m 0755 /var/app/staging
                    - install -d -o ec2-user -g ec2-user -m 0755 /var/log/app
                    - amazon-cloudwatch-agent-ctl -a start || true
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateElasticBeanstalkConfiguration
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - test -d /var/app/current
                    - test -d /var/app/staging
                    - test "$(stat -c '%U' /var/app)" = "ec2-user"
                    - test "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64"
                    - rpm -q httpd amazon-cloudwatch-agent

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder image recipe - CIS Level 1 AL2023 ARM parent, 50 GB gp3 root
  ############################################################################

  EbPreconfiguredImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-preconfigured-al2023-arm'
      Description: >-
        CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 parent image with Elastic
        Beanstalk pre-configuration on a 50 GB encrypted gp3 root volume.
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkPreconfigureComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Architecture: arm64

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder infrastructure configuration - ARM64 instance types
  ############################################################################

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-infra'
      Description: >-
        ARM64 (Graviton) build infrastructure in the template-owned VPC subnet,
        using the template-owned security group, instance profile and log bucket.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.large
        - m7g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuildInstanceSecurityGroup.GroupId
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder distribution configuration - in-region AMI + launch perms
  ############################################################################

  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-distribution'
      Description: >-
        Distributes the hardened Elastic Beanstalk-ready AMI to the current region
        and shares launch permissions with the provided Organization and dummy
        dev/prod account IDs.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-al2023-arm-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: >-
              CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI pre-configured for
              Elastic Beanstalk.
            AmiTags:
              project: elastic-beanstalk-cis-al2023-arm
              environment: shared
              build-pipeline: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
              parent-image: cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm
              os: Amazon Linux 2023
              architecture: arm64
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds: !Split
                - ','
                - !Sub '${DevAccountIds},${ProdAccountIds}'
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder pipeline - daily build with AMI vulnerability scanning
  ############################################################################

  ImageBuilderPipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-pipeline'
      Description: >-
        Daily build of the CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 Elastic
        Beanstalk image, with vulnerability scanning before distribution.
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref EbPreconfiguredImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref BuildScheduleExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      # Enable AMI vulnerability scanning using the Image Builder-owned scan
      # configuration (ImageScanningEnabled is the only scan sub-property used
      # for AMI pipelines; EcrConfiguration is container-only and is omitted).
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: false
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # Image Builder lifecycle policy - delete AMIs older than 6 months (180 days)
  ############################################################################

  ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ami-lifecycle'
      Description: >-
        Automatically deregister and delete AMIs produced by this pipeline once
        they are older than 6 months (180 days).
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - !Ref EbPreconfiguredImageRecipe
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
              Snapshots: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ############################################################################
  # VPC flow logs (VPC, CMK-encrypted CloudWatch Logs destination, retained)
  ############################################################################

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogBucketKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeliverFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderPipeline.Arn

  ImagePipelineName:
    Description: Name of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderPipeline

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the CIS Level 1 AL2023 ARM Elastic Beanstalk image recipe

    Description: ID of the VPC used for Image Builder build instances
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  BuildSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the subnet used for Image Builder build instances
    Value: !Ref BuildSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for testing: a regional
  Amazon API Gateway REST API fronting an AWS Lambda function, secured with
  Amazon Cognito user pool authentication (user pool plus app client), with a
  CORS-enabled preflight method, full access logging to a CMK-encrypted log
  group, X-Ray tracing, encrypted response caching, and an authorized health
  check endpoint.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: API Gateway deployment stage name for the Maths MCP API (also used for tagging).
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool that authenticates MCP callers.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client used by MCP clients.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon Cognito - authentication for the MCP endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  MathsMcpUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role (CloudWatch Logs + X-Ray write)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Maths MCP Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-lambda-role'
        - Key: Stage
          Value: !Ref DeploymentStage

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda function - placeholder Maths MCP handler (updated later)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
      Description: Placeholder Maths MCP server handler (to be replaced with the real implementation).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMcpLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              """Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server."""
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(
                      {
                          "status": "ok",
                          "service": "maths-mcp",
                          "message": "Placeholder handler - implementation pending",
                      }
                  ),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
        - Key: Stage
          Value: !Ref DeploymentStage

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting API Gateway access logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt Maths MCP API Gateway access logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'

  MathsMcpLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MathsMcpLogsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs destination for API Gateway access logs (CMK encrypted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MathsMcpLogsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway account-level CloudWatch Logs role (required for access logging)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Account-level role allowing API Gateway to push access logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-apigw-cw-role'

  MathsMcpApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    DependsOn: MathsMcpCloudWatchLogsRole
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt MathsMcpCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway - regional REST API, authorizer, resources and methods
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      Description: Regional REST API for the serverless Maths MCP server.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
        - Key: Stage
          Value: !Ref DeploymentStage

  MathsMcpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMcpRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  MathsMcpAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn

  # POST /mcp - protected by the Cognito user pool authorizer
  MathsMcpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MathsMcpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # OPTIONS /mcp - CORS preflight, gated with an API key requirement
  MathsMcpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MathsMcpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true

  # GET / - health check, authorized with the same Cognito user pool
  MathsMcpHealthMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMcpRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # Allow API Gateway (this API only) to invoke the Maths MCP Lambda function
  MathsMcpLambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMcpRestApi}/*/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API key supporting resources for the gated OPTIONS preflight
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-preflight-key'
      Description: API key required by the CORS preflight method on the Maths MCP API.
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
          StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

  MathsMcpUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-usage-plan'
      Description: Usage plan associating the Maths MCP preflight API key with the deployed stage.
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
          Stage: !Ref DeploymentStage

  MathsMcpUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref MathsMcpApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref MathsMcpUsagePlan

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deployment and stage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MathsMcpPostMethod
      - MathsMcpOptionsMethod
      - MathsMcpHealthMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      Description: Deployment for the serverless Maths MCP API.

  MathsMcpStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - MathsMcpApiGatewayAccount
      - MathsMcpAccessLogGroup
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MathsMcpDeployment
      Description: Maths MCP API stage.
      TracingEnabled: true
      CacheClusterEnabled: true
      CacheClusterSize: '0.5'
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt MathsMcpAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          MetricsEnabled: true
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          CachingEnabled: true
          CacheDataEncrypted: true
          CacheTtlInSeconds: 300
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 100
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 200
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-stage'
        - Key: Stage
          Value: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL of the deployed Maths MCP API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: Fully qualified URL of the authenticated MCP POST endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: URL of the Cognito-authorized Maths MCP health check endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MathsMcpRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool used to authenticate MCP callers.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool app client used by MCP clients.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPoolClient
  PreflightApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the API key required by the gated CORS preflight method.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpApiKey
