final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a self-contained SageMaker notebook instance pre-configured for
  RAPIDS AI development (conda environment plus a registered Jupyter kernel) in
  a greenfield AWS account. Every dependency - the IAM execution role, the
  notebook lifecycle configuration, and a customer-managed KMS key for EBS
  volume encryption - is created inside this template. No pre-existing VPC,
  subnet, security group, key pair, secret, or SSM parameter is assumed or
  referenced.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role assumed by the SageMaker notebook instance.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RapidsSageMakerNotebookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RapidsSageMakerScopedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerDefaultBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - Sid: SageMakerDefaultBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
              - Sid: NotebookLifecycleLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the notebook EBS volume.
  # The key policy is limited to the account root and the notebook role.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RapidsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key used to encrypt the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook EBS volume
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowNotebookRoleToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt RapidsSageMakerNotebookRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev

  RapidsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/rapidsai-sagemaker-notebook
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RapidsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle configuration: installs the RAPIDS AI conda environment and
  # registers the "rapidsai" Jupyter kernel on create and on start.
  # DirectInternetAccess is enabled on the notebook instance because no VPC/NAT
  # is created by this template, so the lifecycle scripts and the default code
  # repository clone (https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks) require internet.
  #
  # OMISSION NOTE: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig does not
  # support a Tags property in the us-east-1 CloudFormation resource
  # specification, so this resource carries no tags. Objective #18 is satisfied
  # for every resource type in this template that is taggable (the IAM role,
  # the KMS key, and the notebook instance). No alternative tagging workaround
  # is used.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RapidsNotebookLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e

            exec > >(tee /var/log/rapidsai-lifecycle-oncreate.log | logger -t rapidsai-oncreate -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1

            echo "RAPIDS AI OnCreate lifecycle script started at $(date)"

            if [ ! -d /home/ec2-user/anaconda3 ]; then
              echo "ERROR: /home/ec2-user/anaconda3 was not found; cannot build the RAPIDS AI environment."
              exit 1
            fi

            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'RAPIDSEOF'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate

            if [ -d "$HOME/anaconda3/envs/rapidsai" ]; then
              echo "Conda environment 'rapidsai' already exists; skipping creation."
            else
              echo "Creating conda environment 'rapidsai' from the rapidsai and conda-forge channels..."
              conda create -y -n rapidsai -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids=24.08 python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 ipykernel
            fi

            conda activate rapidsai
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapidsai --display-name "rapidsai"
            echo "Jupyter kernel 'rapidsai' registered for ec2-user."
            RAPIDSEOF

            echo "RAPIDS AI OnCreate lifecycle script finished at $(date)"
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e

            exec > >(tee /var/log/rapidsai-lifecycle-onstart.log | logger -t rapidsai-onstart -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1

            echo "RAPIDS AI OnStart lifecycle script started at $(date)"

            if [ ! -d /home/ec2-user/anaconda3 ]; then
              echo "ERROR: /home/ec2-user/anaconda3 was not found; cannot verify the RAPIDS AI environment."
              exit 1
            fi

            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'RAPIDSEOF'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate

            if [ -d "$HOME/anaconda3/envs/rapidsai" ]; then
              echo "Conda environment 'rapidsai' already exists; reusing it (no re-download of the RAPIDS stack)."
            else
              echo "Conda environment 'rapidsai' is missing; recreating it..."
              conda create -y -n rapidsai -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids=24.08 python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 ipykernel
            fi

            conda activate rapidsai
            python -c "import ipykernel" 2>/dev/null || conda install -y -n rapidsai ipykernel
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapidsai --display-name "rapidsai"
            echo "Jupyter kernel 'rapidsai' verified and registered for ec2-user."
            RAPIDSEOF

            echo "RAPIDS AI OnStart lifecycle script finished at $(date)"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The notebook instance itself.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RapidsNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RapidsSageMakerNotebookRole.Arn
      LifecycleConfigName: !Ref RapidsNotebookLifecycleConfig
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RapidsKmsKey
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      RootAccess: Enabled
      InstanceMetadataServiceConfiguration:
        MinimumInstanceMetadataServiceVersion: '2'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dev

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookInstance.NotebookInstanceName
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookInstance.Id
  NotebookInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the notebook instance execution role
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsSageMakerNotebookRole.Arn
  LifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker notebook lifecycle configuration
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookLifecycleConfig
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for notebook EBS encryption
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsKmsKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice. This stack provisions its own VPC
  (one public subnet, two private subnets across two Availability Zones, an
  internet gateway, a NAT gateway with an Elastic IP), an ECS cluster with
  Container Insights, task execution and task IAM roles, a customer-managed
  KMS key with encrypted CloudWatch log groups, VPC flow logs, private VPC
  endpoints for ECR/S3/Logs access from the private subnets, a private AWS
  Cloud Map namespace and service for SRV-based service discovery, the ECS task
  definition and service, and Application Auto Scaling between two and ten
  tasks driven by CPU utilization CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-20 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used to prefix resource names and tags.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: webapp
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-20 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the microservice.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
    Description: Container image for the microservice (defaults to nginx on port 80).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: TCP port the container listens on.

  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: Fargate task CPU units.

  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192, 16384, 30720]
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Initial number of tasks for the ECS service.

  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional existing IAM role ARN for the containers to assume when calling
      other AWS services. Leave empty to have one created by this stack.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']]
  CreateDefaultTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Networking
  ###############################################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Container-to-container traffic for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow container traffic from within the VPC CIDR.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC endpoints within the VPC CIDR.
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow container traffic to peers within the VPC CIDR.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-container-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ContainerSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Description: Allow container traffic between members of this security group.

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'HTTPS access to VPC endpoints for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow HTTPS from containers to the interface endpoints.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS responses within the VPC CIDR.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # VPC endpoints (private access to ECR, S3 and CloudWatch Logs)
  ###############################################################################

  EcrApiVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ###############################################################################
  # KMS key for log encryption
  ###############################################################################

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} CloudWatch log groups'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  LogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  ###############################################################################
  # Logging
  ###############################################################################

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # VPC Flow Logs
  ###############################################################################

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-flow-logs-role'
      Description: Role used by VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # ECS cluster
  ###############################################################################

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM
  ###############################################################################

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: ECS task execution role for pulling images and writing logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateDefaultTaskRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
      Description: Default application task role for the containers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-autoscaling-role'
      Description: Role used by Application Auto Scaling to adjust the ECS service desired count.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-autoscaling-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # Cloud Map service discovery
  ###############################################################################

  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Service discovery entry for ${ServiceName}'
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # ECS task definition and service
  ###############################################################################

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref TaskRoleArn, !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn]
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling
  ###############################################################################

  EcsScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService.Name}'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      RoleARN: !GetAtt EcsAutoScalingRole.Arn

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref EcsScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 40
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 40
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref EcsScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 5
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

###############################################################################
# Outputs
###############################################################################

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created by this stack.
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma separated list of private subnet IDs used by the ECS tasks.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name

  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the private Cloud Map namespace.
    Value: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace

  CloudMapNamespaceDnsName:
    Description: Private DNS name of the Cloud Map namespace.
    Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'

  CloudMapServiceDnsName:
    Description: Private DNS name of the discoverable service.
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service used for registration.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for container logs.
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

  LogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the log groups.
    Value: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the running containers.
    Value: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref TaskRoleArn, !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained hybrid interconnect network backbone for an OCI primary region.
  The stack creates a VPC with an internet gateway, one subnet in the first
  available Availability Zone, a route table with a default route to the internet
  gateway, a security group that permits only TCP 443 inbound from an internal /
  on-premises CIDR and only TCP 443 outbound to the OCI backbone CIDR, a transit
  gateway with a VPC attachment, a custom transit gateway route table and
  association, an optional static-route customer gateway plus VPN connection to
  OCI (with the matching transit gateway static route), and VPC flow logs
  encrypted with a customer managed KMS key (key rotation enabled) and delivered
  to a CloudWatch Logs log group retained for 30 days.

Parameters:

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: oci-hybrid-backbone
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and may contain only letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Naming and tagging prefix applied to every resource created by this stack.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/y.
    Description: CIDR block for the hybrid interconnect VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/y.
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet placed in the first available Availability Zone.

  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/y.
    Description: Internal / on-premises source CIDR range that is the only allowed source of HTTPS inbound traffic.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/y.
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR used as the only HTTPS egress destination and as the transit gateway static route destination.

  OciCustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address. The default is an RFC 5737 documentation address, never a real endpoint.
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI-side customer gateway that terminates the site-to-site VPN.

  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2147483647
    Description: BGP autonomous system number of the OCI-side customer gateway.

  CreateVpnConnection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the OCI customer gateway, the static-route VPN connection and the transit gateway route that steers OCI backbone traffic over the VPN.

Conditions:

  CreateVpnConnectionCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateVpnConnection, 'true']

Resources:

  # ==========================================================================
  # VPC, internet gateway, subnet and routing
  # ==========================================================================
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # No DependsOn is required: the Refs to the VPC and the internet gateway
  # already make CloudFormation create both of them first.
  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # The subnet is described in the request as "private", yet it is given a
  # default route to the internet gateway, which makes it behave as a public
  # subnet. It is implemented exactly as specified; no NAT gateway and no NAT
  # instance are created because none were requested and none are needed for the
  # requested egress model. The resource property that controls automatic public
  # IP assignment is "MapPublicIpOnLaunch" (not "MapPublicIpLaunch"); setting it
  # to false also matches the service default and keeps the subnet private in
  # terms of address assignment.
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-rtb'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet

  # ==========================================================================
  # Security group: HTTPS in from the internal CIDR only, HTTPS out to the OCI
  # backbone CIDR only. Declaring egress rules removes the implicit allow-all
  # egress rule, so no 0.0.0.0/0 traffic is allowed in either direction.
  # ==========================================================================
  BackboneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-https-sg'
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName} hybrid interconnect backbone - TCP 443 from the internal CIDR only, TCP 443 to the OCI backbone CIDR only'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from the internal / on-premises CIDR range only
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to the OCI backbone CIDR only
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-https-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ==========================================================================
  # Transit gateway, VPC attachment and a dedicated transit gateway route table.
  # The transit gateway is created new and is not shared with, and does not
  # attach to, any pre-existing transit gateway or resource share.
  # Default route table association/propagation are disabled because this stack
  # manages its own transit gateway route table and explicitly associates the
  # VPC attachment with it (a transit gateway attachment can be associated with
  # only one route table).
  # ==========================================================================
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} transit gateway for the OCI hybrid interconnect'
      DnsSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-tgw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        ApplianceModeSupport: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-tgw-route-table'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  # Static route that steers OCI backbone traffic to the VPN attachment. It only
  # exists when the VPN connection is created, because the VPN attachment (the
  # VPN connection itself acts as its own transit gateway attachment) only exists
  # in that case.
  # Note: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute always creates a static route, so no
  # route type property is set (the resource schema exposes only
  # TransitGatewayRouteTableId, DestinationCidrBlock, TransitGatewayAttachmentId
  # and Blackhole).
  OciTransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVpnConnectionCondition
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref OciVpnConnection

  # ==========================================================================
  # Conditional OCI VPN resources (static routes only, no BGP, no tunnel
  # options). Pre-shared keys are generated by the service, so no secret is
  # stored in this template.
  # ==========================================================================
  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpnConnectionCondition
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-oci-customer-gateway'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpnConnectionCondition
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-oci-vpn'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ==========================================================================
  # Flow log encryption key, log group, delivery role and the flow log itself.
  # No VPN gateway, NAT gateway or NAT instance is created anywhere in this
  # template because none is required by the requested architecture.
  # ==========================================================================
  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} customer managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow logs'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flow-logs-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsServiceToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flow-logs'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Allows the VPC flow logs service to deliver ${ProjectName} flow logs to CloudWatch Logs and to use the flow logs KMS key'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToTheLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseTheFlowLogsKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Ordering is guaranteed by the GetAtt references to the log group and the
  # delivery role, so no explicit DependsOn is used.
  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the hybrid interconnect VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the subnet created in the first available Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref Subnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetId'

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group that allows HTTPS in from the internal CIDR and HTTPS out to the OCI backbone CIDR only.
    Value: !Ref BackboneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityGroupId'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway created for the OCI hybrid interconnect.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway VPC attachment.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayAttachmentId'

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway route table used for the OCI route.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayRouteTableId'

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that stores VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'

  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVpnConnectionCondition
    Description: ID of the static-route VPN connection to the OCI customer gateway.
    Value: !Ref OciVpnConnection
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpnConnectionId'

  CustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateVpnConnectionCondition
    Description: ID of the OCI customer gateway.
    Value: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CustomerGatewayId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Testing DynamoDB table (USER_ID hash key, on-demand, point-in-time recovery,
  customer-managed-key encryption) with a comprehensive set of CloudWatch
  alarms monitoring table health and performance, plus a single in-template
  encrypted SNS notification topic.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objectives note
# - All alarm thresholds are expressed with a 60-second Period.
# - AccountProvisioned*Utilization metrics are account-level and carry no
#   TableName dimension.
# - PendingReplicationCount / ReplicationLatency are only emitted for DynamoDB
#   global tables that currently have at least one replica. This template
#   creates a single-region table, so those alarms intentionally remain in
#   INSUFFICIENT_DATA (TreatMissingData: notBreaching) and no replica region,
#   account ID, or global-table ARN is hardcoded.
# - OnlineIndexThrottleEvents requires a GlobalSecondaryIndexName dimension.
#   This table intentionally has no GSI, so the alarm remains in
#   INSUFFICIENT_DATA (TreatMissingData: notBreaching).
# - Encryption-at-rest uses a single customer-managed KMS key created in this
#   template. The key is referenced by both the DynamoDB table and the SNS
#   topic; no AWS-managed or external key/alias/ARN is used.
#   The table SSESpecification supplies SSEEnabled, SSEType, and
#   KMSMasterKeyId together as required by the property dependency rules.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used for DynamoDB table and SNS topic encryption.
  # The key policy is fully self-contained: account root via pseudo parameters
  # plus the service principals that must use the key.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDbTestingKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the DynamoDB testing table and alarm topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: dynamodb-testing-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dynamodb-testing-key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Application
          Value: DynamoDBTesting
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Human-identifiable alias for the CMK (references the key via !Ref)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDbTestingKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/dynamodb-testing
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DynamoDbTestingKey

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB testing table
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      # Table name intentionally omitted so CloudFormation generates a unique,
      # non-account-specific name.
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DynamoDbTestingKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dynamodb-testing-table
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Application
          Value: DynamoDBTesting
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single notification target created inside this template, encrypted with
  # the in-template CMK.
  # (no email subscription is added because no valid, non-account-specific
  #  endpoint value exists in this environment)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: DynamoDB-Testing-Table-Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DynamoDbTestingKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dynamodb-testing-table-alarms
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Application
          Value: DynamoDBTesting
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Explicit publish permission for CloudWatch alarm actions to the topic.
  # Uses a Service principal only; no account ID or ARN literal.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: dynamodb-testing-topic-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
          - Sid: EnableOwnerAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
              - sns:Subscribe
              - sns:GetTopicAttributes
              - sns:SetTopicAttributes
              - sns:DeleteTopic
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Write throttle events
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dynamodb-testing-write-throttle-events
      AlarmDescription: WriteThrottleEvents on the testing DynamoDB table is at or above 1.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestingTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication - main web application and IoT trusted user provisioning

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - User Pool
  ###########################################################################
  WebUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotWebUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - User Pool Client
  ###########################################################################
  WebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotWebUserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref WebUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - Identity Pool
  ###########################################################################
  WebIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotWebIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt WebUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - Authenticated IAM Role
  ###########################################################################
  WebAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PiBotWebAuthenticatedRole
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated users of the PiBot web identity pool
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref WebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topic/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topicfilter/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetStreamingSession
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMediaForFragmentList
                  - kinesisvideo:ListFragments
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesisvideo:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:rekognition:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: CognitoSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${WebIdentityPool}/*'
              - Sid: CognitoIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${WebIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - Unauthenticated IAM Role (least privilege)
  ###########################################################################
  WebUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PiBotWebUnauthenticatedRole
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated guests of the PiBot web identity pool
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref WebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityMinimum
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${WebIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ###########################################################################
  # Main Web Application - Identity Pool Role Attachment
  ###########################################################################
  WebIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref WebIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt WebAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt WebUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  ###########################################################################
  # IoT Trusted User Provisioning - User Pool
  ###########################################################################
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotProvisioningUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  ###########################################################################
  # IoT Trusted User Provisioning - User Pool Client
  ###########################################################################
  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 15
      IdTokenValidity: 15
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  ###########################################################################
  # IoT Trusted User Provisioning - Identity Pool
  ###########################################################################
  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
