AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context
  Protocol) integration supporting AI agents for protein variant effect
  prediction. Creates its own minimum prerequisites (a placeholder prediction
  Lambda function with active X-Ray tracing and a Cognito user pool/app client),
  publishes their identifiers to SSM Parameter Store, and provisions the
  AgentCore Gateway with a CUSTOM_JWT inbound authorizer plus a Lambda-backed
  MCP gateway target exposing the invoke_endpoint and get_results tools.

# =============================================================================
# GREENFIELD RECONCILIATION
#
# This account has no pre-existing infrastructure, so this stack is
# self-contained: it CREATES every resource identifier it consumes and SEEDS
# SSM Parameter Store for downstream consumers. Specifically it creates:
#   - a minimum placeholder prediction AWS::Lambda::Function (inline code, no
#     VPC, no layers, no external artifacts, no reserved concurrency) and its
#     execution role;
#   - an AWS::Cognito::UserPool plus a public (secret-less) UserPoolClient used
#     as the gateway's JWT identity source;
# and publishes, using !GetAtt / !Ref values only:
#   - /<ProjectName>/gateway/role-arn      = gateway execution role ARN
#   - /<ProjectName>/lambda/arn            = prediction function ARN
#   - /<ProjectName>/cognito/discovery-url = OIDC discovery URL
#   - /<ProjectName>/cognito/client-id     = Cognito app client ID
# No value is read back from an external source: no AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value
# parameters, no {{resolve:ssm:...}}, no {{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}, no
# {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}, no Fn::ImportValue and no hardcoded ARNs,
# account ids or resource ids appear anywhere in this template.
#
# Scope substitution (explicit): the original requirement placed Lambda and
# Cognito creation out of scope and expected those identifiers to be resolved
# from SSM. In a greenfield account no such SSM entries exist and a
# value-typed SSM parameter cannot bind, so the minimum placeholder function and
# identity source are created here to keep the stack deployable and to own the
# seeding of those conventional SSM keys.
#
# STANDING CONVENTION - LAMBDA OBSERVABILITY: every AWS::Lambda::Function in
# this stack MUST declare active tracing at creation time
# (TracingConfig.Mode: Active). Omitted or PassThrough tracing fails the
# AWS-0066 check, and the function's execution role must in turn be granted the
# minimum X-Ray trace-emission permissions. Apply this convention to any Lambda
# added in a future revision (for example if the placeholder is split into
# separate submit/poll functions) rather than adding tracing retroactively.
# =============================================================================
# OPEN RISK: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway and AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
#   together with the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer and MCP target property shapes used
#   below must be verified against the current CloudFormation resource
#   specification for the target region BEFORE deployment. If those resource
#   types (or those property shapes) are not yet available in the region, the
#   Gateway and GatewayTarget resources must be deferred - they must NOT be
#   replaced with a substituted or hallucinated resource type.
# =============================================================================

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'must be 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only'
    Description: >-
      Project slug used to derive every resource name, SSM parameter path and
      gateway name default created by this stack.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: >-
      MCP gateway that exposes protein variant effect prediction tools
      (invoke_endpoint, get_results) to AI agents.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 48
    Description: >-
      Optional name for the AgentCore Gateway. Leave empty to auto-generate
      "<ProjectName>-gateway".

Conditions:
  UseProvidedGatewayName: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ''

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Minimum placeholder prediction Lambda function (created in-template because
  # its ARN is a required resource identifier for the gateway execution role
  # policy and the gateway target configuration). Active tracing is mandatory -
  # see the standing convention in the header comment.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PredictionFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-lambda-role'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role for the ${ProjectName} placeholder protein variant effect
        prediction function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-lambda-xray'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EmitXRaySegments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadXRaySamplingRules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'

  PredictionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction'
      Description: >-
        Placeholder backend that serves the invoke_endpoint and get_results MCP
        tools for protein variant effect prediction.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt PredictionFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid

          _JOBS = {}


          def _response(payload, status_code=200):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status_code,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(payload),
              }


          def _extract_tool_input(event):
              if isinstance(event, dict):
                  if isinstance(event.get("input"), dict):
                      return event["input"]
                  if isinstance(event.get("arguments"), dict):
                      return event["arguments"]
                  body = event.get("body")
                  if isinstance(body, str):
                      try:
                          parsed = json.loads(body)
                      except ValueError:
                          return {}
                      if isinstance(parsed, dict) and isinstance(parsed.get("input"), dict):
                          return parsed["input"]
              return {}


          def handler(event, context):
              if not isinstance(event, dict):
                  return _response({"error": "invalid request"}, 400)

              tool_name = event.get("name") or event.get("tool") or ""
              tool_input = _extract_tool_input(event)

              if tool_name == "invoke_endpoint":
                  sequence = tool_input.get("sequence")
                  if not sequence:
                      return _response({"error": "sequence is required"}, 400)
                  job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  _JOBS[job_id] = {
                      "status": "SUCCEEDED",
                      "sequence": sequence,
                      "variant": tool_input.get("variant"),
                      "model": tool_input.get("model", "default"),
                      "scores": [
                          {
                              "variant": tool_input.get("variant") or "reference",
                              "effect_score": 0.0,
                          }
                      ],
                  }
                  return _response({"job_id": job_id, "status": "SUBMITTED"})

              if tool_name == "get_results":
                  job_id = tool_input.get("job_id")
                  if not job_id:
                      return _response({"error": "job_id is required"}, 400)
                  job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
                  if job is None:
                      return _response({"job_id": job_id, "status": "NOT_FOUND"}, 404)
                  return _response(
                      {
                          "job_id": job_id,
                          "status": job["status"],
                          "scores": job["scores"],
                      }
                  )

              return _response({"error": "unsupported tool: %s" % tool_name}, 400)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito identity source backing the gateway CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-users'
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway execution role: assumed by the AgentCore Gateway service to invoke
  # downstream targets. Retained on stack deletion because other AgentCore
  # components discover it by ARN.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role assumed by the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for the
        ${ProjectName} MCP gateway.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreGatewayToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-invoke-prediction-lambda'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePredictionLambdaFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM publication: this stack SEEDS the conventional discovery keys for
  # downstream consumers. Values are !GetAtt / !Ref only - no dynamic
  # references are used to read back this stack's own parameters.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/gateway/role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: !Sub >-
        ARN of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway execution role for the
        ${ProjectName} project.

  PredictionLambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/lambda/arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn
      Description: !Sub >-
        ARN of the ${ProjectName} protein variant effect prediction function.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: !Sub >-
        OpenID Connect discovery URL for the ${ProjectName} gateway JWT
        authorizer.

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
      Description: !Sub >-
        Cognito app client ID allowed to call the ${ProjectName} MCP gateway.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway: MCP protocol, Cognito JWT inbound authorization, gateway
  # execution role created above.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - UseProvidedGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: MCP
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway target: binds the gateway to the prediction Lambda and publishes the
  # inline MCP tool schema for LLM tool selection.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-tools'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Lambda-backed MCP target exposing the ${ProjectName} protein variant
        effect prediction tools.
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >-
                    Submit a protein sequence, plus an optional amino-acid
                    variant, for variant effect prediction. Starts an
                    asynchronous prediction job and returns the job identifier
                    that must be polled with the get_results operation.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: >-
                          Reference protein sequence in single-letter
                          amino-acid code, for example MKTAYIAKQRQISFVKSHFSRQ.
                      variant:
                        Type: string
                        Description: >-
                          Optional variant to score against the reference
                          sequence, in HGVS protein notation such as
                          p.Ala123Val. Omit to score the reference sequence.
                      model:
                        Type: string
                        Description: >-
                          Optional identifier of the prediction model to use.
                          The service default model is used when omitted.
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >-
                    Retrieve the status and scores of a previously submitted
                    prediction job. Returns the job state and, once the job has
                    completed, the per-variant effect scores.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: >-
                          Job identifier returned by the invoke_endpoint
                          operation.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn

  GatewayExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the gateway when invoking targets.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name that publishes the gateway execution role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter

  PredictionFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the placeholder protein variant effect prediction function.
    Value: !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL used by the gateway JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  CognitoClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID allowed to call the gateway.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Audit events queue stack. Creates a KMS-encrypted (customer managed key with automatic
  rotation) SQS queue, an optional dead letter queue with a redrive policy that is only
  created in non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for oldest-message age, queue backlog
  and DLQ activity, and a KMS-encrypted SNS topic used as the single alarm notification
  target. The stack is self-contained: every resource it depends on is created in this
  template. No dynamic references, no cross-stack imports and no hardcoded infrastructure IDs.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment. Drives naming, tagging, DLQ creation and per-environment sizing.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of dev, staging or prod.

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional email address subscribed to the alarm SNS topic. Leave empty (default) to
      create no subscription - no endpoint is fabricated in this template.
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 254

Conditions:
  # Dead letter queue, redrive policy and DLQ alarm only exist outside dev.
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  # Subscription is only created when an address was actually supplied.
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Mappings:
  # Per-environment sizing. Defaults is a defensive fallback block keyed in the same
  # mapping so values can still be resolved if a new environment is ever allowed.
  EnvConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessageThreshold: 1800
      ApproximateNumberOfMessagesThreshold: 100
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessageThreshold: 1200
      ApproximateNumberOfMessagesThreshold: 500
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      MaxReceiveCount: 10
      ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessageThreshold: 900
      ApproximateNumberOfMessagesThreshold: 1000
    Defaults:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessageThreshold: 1800
      ApproximateNumberOfMessagesThreshold: 100

Resources:
  ##############################################################################
  # Encryption: customer managed KMS key + friendly alias
  #
  # The key policy authorizes the account root (administration) and the two AWS
  # service principals that encrypt on behalf of this stack: SQS (queue messages)
  # and SNS (alarm notifications on the encrypted alert topic). Each service
  # statement is constrained by kms:ViaService so the principals cannot be used
  # as a confused deputy against this key from other services or regions.
  ##############################################################################
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${AWS::StackName} audit event queue and alert topic encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - kms:Decrypt
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  ##############################################################################
  # Primary audit events queue
  #
  # RedrivePolicy is applied conditionally: the dead letter queue only exists when
  # IsNonDev is true, so in dev the property must be removed (AWS::NoValue) rather
  # than referencing a resource that is not part of the stack. Fn::If evaluates the
  # IsNonDev branch - and therefore the !GetAtt to AuditEventsDlq - only when the
  # DLQ actually exists, which keeps the dev deployment valid.
  ##############################################################################
  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds]
      DelaySeconds: 0
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # Dead letter queue (non-dev only)
  #
  # RedriveAllowPolicy: allowAll is used instead of byQueue/sourceQueueArns because
  # sourceQueueArns would have to reference the primary queue ARN. The primary queue
  # already references the DLQ ARN through RedrivePolicy, so a byQueue listing would
  # create a circular dependency between the two queues.
  ##############################################################################
  AuditEventsDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: allowAll
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # Alerting: encrypted SNS topic (single alarm target) + optional email subscription
  #
  # KmsMasterKeyId references the customer managed key created in this template,
  # so alarm notifications are encrypted at rest and in transit for the topic.
  # Referencing the key ARN also gives CloudFormation the required implicit
  # dependency on AuditEventsKey; no DependsOn is needed.
  ##############################################################################
  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-alerts-${Environment}'
      DisplayName: !Sub 'Audit events alerts (${Environment})'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AlertSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  ##############################################################################
  # Alarms
  ##############################################################################
  AuditEventsOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-oldest-message-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Oldest message on the ${Environment} audit events queue exceeds the environment threshold.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessageThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AuditEventsBacklogAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-backlog-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Visible message backlog on the ${Environment} audit events queue exceeds the environment threshold.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, ApproximateNumberOfMessagesThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AuditEventsDlqNotEmptyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-audit-events-dlq-not-empty-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Failed audit event messages are present on the ${Environment} dead letter queue.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: audit-events
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsQueueUrl'

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsQueueArn'

  AuditEventsDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev environments only).
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsDlq
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsDlqUrl'

  AuditEventsDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev environments only).
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsDlqArn'

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the audit event queues and alert topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsKmsKeyArn'

  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the audit event queues and alert topic.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsKmsKeyAlias'

  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted SNS topic that receives all audit event alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsAlertTopicArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API (CryptoTickerAPI) that fetches current
  cryptocurrency ticker prices from the public CoinGecko HTTP endpoint and stores
  historical price records in the DynamoDB table APIDataTable.

Resources:

  APIDataTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used for encryption at rest of the APIDataTable DynamoDB table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  APIDataTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-APIDataTable'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref APIDataTableKey

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt APIDataTableKey.Arn

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSync-DynamoDB-Role'
      Description: Role assumed by AppSync to query and write ticker history records in APIDataTable.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: APIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTableKey.Arn

  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSync-CloudWatchLogs-Role'
      Description: Role assumed by AppSync to publish field level logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs'

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true

  CryptoTickerAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceHistoryItem]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryItem {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

  CryptoTickerAPIApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key used to access the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL endpoint.
      Expires: 1767225600

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: Unsigned public HTTP data source pointing at the CoinGecko price API.
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source backed by the APIDataTable table.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: fetchTickerPrice
      Description: Fetches the current USD price of the requested ticker from CoinGecko.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$util.urlEncode($ctx.args.ticker)",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker)
        #set($price = $ctx.result.body.get($ticker).get("usd"))
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": $ticker,
          "price": $price,
          "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
        })

  SavePriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: savePriceHistory
      Description: Writes the fetched price as a historical record into APIDataTable.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  TickerPipelineResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt SavePriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({})
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.ticker, $ctx.source.ticker))
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "#hk = :hk",
            "expressionNames": {
              "#hk": "hk"
            },
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.nextToken, null))
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: HTTPS endpoint of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the default API key used to authenticate against CryptoTickerAPI.
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPIApiKey.ApiKeyId

  APIDataTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores ticker price history records.
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

  APIDataTableKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting APIDataTable at rest.
    Value: !GetAtt APIDataTableKey.Arn

    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, or hyphens."
    Description: "Logical name prefix applied to every resource created by this template."

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    Description: "Environment name applied to the Environment tag of every taggable resource."

  CustomTags:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^([^=]+=.*)?$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Each entry must use Key=Value form, for example Owner=MediaTeam,CostCenter=1234."
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-separated list of custom tags in Key=Value form. Up to four entries are
      applied, in order, to every taggable resource in addition to the Name and Environment tags.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Packaging output type. APPLE_HLS (default) creates only the HLS origin endpoint,
      ISO_DASH creates only the DASH origin endpoint, and ALL creates both.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
    Description: "Manifest file name exposed by the origin endpoints."

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: "Segment duration in seconds used by the HLS origin endpoint and the HLS VOD package."

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: "Maximum time in seconds that a client can rewind (start-over) within the live stream."

  ArchiveBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9])?$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Leave empty or provide a valid S3 bucket name (3-63 lowercase characters)."
    Description: >-
      Optional name for the S3 bucket that this template creates to store live-to-VOD archived
      content. When supplied, both origin endpoints are exported with Origination set to DENY.

  VodSourceBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9])?$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Leave empty or provide a valid S3 bucket name (3-63 lowercase characters)."
    Description: >-
      Optional name for the S3 bucket that this template creates to hold VOD source content.
      When supplied, the MediaPackage VOD workflow (packaging group, packaging configuration
      and asset) is provisioned.

Conditions:

  # Live-to-VOD behavior: supplying an archive bucket exports the live stream and flips
  # every origin endpoint to Origination DENY; otherwise the endpoints stay in ALLOW mode.
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucketName, ""]]

  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucketName, ""]]

  CreateVodWorkflow: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucketName, ""]]

  HasS3Buckets: !Or
    - Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    - Condition: HasVodSourceBucket

  # Output type driven packaging set. Note that the default (APPLE_HLS) therefore produces
  # only the HLS origin endpoint unless ALL is chosen, and ISO_DASH produces only DASH.
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]

  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]

  # CustomTags is a CommaDelimitedList of Key=Value entries. The list is joined back into a
  # string and re-split with Fn::Split so that a fixed number of entries (four) can be selected
  # deterministically; the trailing empty entries keep Fn::Select in range at all times.
  HasCustomTag1: !Not [!Equals [!Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]], ""]]
  HasCustomTag2: !Not [!Equals [!Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]], ""]]
  HasCustomTag3: !Not [!Equals [!Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]], ""]]
  HasCustomTag4: !Not [!Equals [!Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]], ""]]

Resources:

  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-channel"
      Description: !Sub "Live streaming channel for the ${Environment} environment (${NamePrefix})"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-channel"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-hls"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub "HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-hls"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-dash"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub "DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      # DASH segment duration is intentionally hardcoded to 2 seconds (not parameterized).
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-dash"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  # Customer managed KMS key used for SSE-KMS on the data buckets. Its key policy intentionally
  # names only the account root principal (enabling IAM policy delegation) and never references
  # MediaPackageVodRole, which keeps the dependency graph acyclic.
  MediaPackageDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: HasS3Buckets
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key used to encrypt the MediaPackage buckets created by ${NamePrefix}"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-data-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  # AWS::KMS::Alias does not support tags; kept tag-free by design.
  MediaPackageDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: HasS3Buckets
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${NamePrefix}-data"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MediaPackageDataKey

  # Dedicated server-access-log destination bucket. It intentionally uses SSE-S3 (AES256)
  # because SSE-KMS is not supported for S3 server access-log destinations, and it has no
  # LoggingConfiguration of its own since it is the destination.
  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasS3Buckets
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-access-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  # Allows the S3 log delivery service to write access logs into the log bucket (policy-based
  # rather than ACL-based, so no AccessControl property is used anywhere in this template).
  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: HasS3Buckets
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${LogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucketName
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: archive/
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-archive"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucketName
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageDataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: vod-source/
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-source"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasS3Buckets
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-role"
      Description: !Sub "Allows MediaPackage VOD to read and write the buckets created by ${NamePrefix}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-bucket-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceAndArchiveBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !If [HasArchiveBucket, !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}", !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
                  - !If [HasVodSourceBucket, !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}", !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
              - Sid: ReadWriteSourceAndArchiveObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !If [HasArchiveBucket, !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*", !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
                  - !If [HasVodSourceBucket, !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*", !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
              - Sid: UseDataEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MediaPackageDataKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [0, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [1, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag3
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [2, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag4
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ["=", !Select [3, !Split [",", !Join [",", [!Join [",", !Ref CustomTags], "", "", "", ""]]]]]]
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  # Note: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup accepts only Id (required) plus Authorization,
  # Tags and EgressAccessLogs. It has no Description property, so descriptive intent is kept
  # here as a comment instead.
  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-group"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
