AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM roles, instance profiles and managed
  policies supporting both EC2-based and EKS-based Kubernetes cluster
  lifecycle management. Fully self-contained.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-role'
      Description: CAPA control plane role assumed by EC2 for EC2-based clusters
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-role'
      Description: CAPA controllers role usable as EC2 instance profile and via EKS Pod Identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEksPodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-role'
      Description: CAPA worker node role for EC2 and EKS worker nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane-role'
      Description: EKS cluster service role for EKS-based control planes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEksAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles (one per CAPA role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy: control plane
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-policy'
      Description: Broad EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling and KMS permissions for CAPA control plane machines
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2ControlPlaneInstances
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:RebootInstances
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingClassicAndV2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingControlPlane
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSControlPlane
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy: controllers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControllersManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-policy'
      Description: Broad networking, load balancing, autoscaling, launch template and EKS access entry permissions for CAPA controllers
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: VPCNetworking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EC2InstancesAndVolumes
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LaunchTemplates
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingControllers
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingControllers
            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters

            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy: controllers-eks (attached to controllers AND control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControllersEKSManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-eks-policy'
      Description: EKS cluster and nodegroup lifecycle, SSM and IAM read-only inspection, conditioned KMS, and EKS service-linked role creation
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion

              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey

              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:RequestAlias': 'alias/*cluster-api-provider-aws*'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'kms:ResourceAliases': 'alias/*cluster-api-provider-aws*'
          - Sid: CreateEKSServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate.amazonaws.com/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom managed policy: nodes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  NodesManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-policy'
      Description: Node bootstrap, ECR pull, SSM, S3 read and scoped Secrets Manager access for CAPA worker nodes
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeBootstrap
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRPull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerCAPI
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SSMNode
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: S3Read
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControllersInstanceProfileName:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for the
  x86_64 and arm64 architectures with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages
  (synapseclient, pandas, pysftp) and sudo access for the SSM user, then
  distributes the AMIs publicly and shares them with an AWS Organization.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Build Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Distribution Settings
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
    ParameterLabels:
      ImageVersion:
        default: Image version
      RootVolumeSize:
        default: Root volume size (GiB)
      OrganizationId:
        default: AWS Organization ID

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID, for example o-abc123defg.
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations ID (for example o-abc123defg) that the resulting AMIs are
      shared with. Replace the placeholder default with your organization ID.
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must use semantic versioning, for example 1.0.0.
    Description: Version applied to the Image Builder components and image recipes.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16000
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the produced AMIs.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # KMS key used to encrypt the build notification SNS topic and log group
  ##########################################################################

  NotificationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt Image Builder build notification resources.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##########################################################################
  # Networking used by the EC2 Image Builder build instances
  ##########################################################################

  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'

  BuildInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-igw'

  BuildVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-subnet'

  BuildNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-nat-eip'

  BuildNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: BuildVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt BuildNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: BuildVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-rt'

  BuildDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref BuildNatGateway

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3.
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon DynamoDB.
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to AWS Systems Manager endpoints.
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to AWS Systems Manager messages endpoints.
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon EC2 messages endpoints.
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon CloudFront (edge endpoints).
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.cloudfront'
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          Description: DNS resolution through the VPC resolver.
          CidrIp: !GetAtt BuildVpc.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          Description: DNS resolution through the VPC resolver.
          CidrIp: !GetAtt BuildVpc.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-sg'

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC Flow Logs
  ##########################################################################

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt NotificationKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: Role used by VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt NotificationKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  BuildVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref BuildVpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM for the EC2 Image Builder build instances
  ##########################################################################

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ##########################################################################
  # SNS topic for build status notifications
  ##########################################################################

  BuildNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-notifications'
      DisplayName: EC2 Image Builder build notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt NotificationKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  BuildNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BuildNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref BuildNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ##########################################################################
  # EC2 Image Builder components
  ##########################################################################

  DockerInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-install-docker-python-ssm-sudo'
      Description: >-
        Installs Docker, Docker Compose and the Python packages synapseclient,
        pandas and pysftp, and grants the SSM user passwordless sudo access.
      Platform: Linux
      Type: BUILD
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial build component.
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: install-docker-python-ssm-sudo
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and enable ssm-user sudo.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: update-os
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf update -y
              - name: install-docker-python
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y docker python3 python3-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: install-docker-compose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - >-
                      COMPOSE_ARCH=$( [ "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64" ] && echo aarch64 || echo x86_64 );
                      curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-${COMPOSE_ARCH}" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose;
                      chmod +x /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: install-python-packages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: configure-ssm-user-sudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - id ssm-user >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - printf '%s\n' 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  DockerVerificationComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-verify-docker-python'
      Description: >-
        Verifies that Docker Compose is functional and that the Python packages
        synapseclient, pandas and pysftp can be imported, failing the build
        otherwise.
      Platform: Linux
      Type: TEST
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: Initial test component.
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: verify-docker-python
        description: Verify Docker Compose is functional and required Python packages import.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: verify-docker-compose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - systemctl is-active docker || systemctl start docker
                    - docker compose version
              - name: verify-python-imports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp"

  ##########################################################################
  # Image recipes (x86_64 and arm64)
  ##########################################################################

  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64'
      Description: >-
        Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 recipe with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tooling.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref DockerInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref DockerVerificationComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Architecture: x86_64

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Description: >-
        Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 recipe with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tooling.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref DockerInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref DockerVerificationComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        Architecture: arm64

  ##########################################################################
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  ##########################################################################

  ImageBuilderInfrastructure:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared build infrastructure for the Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - c7g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref BuildNotificationTopic
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##########################################################################
  # Single shared distribution configuration
  ##########################################################################

  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: >-
        Distributes the AMIs publicly and shares them with the target AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-ami'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI built with EC2 Image Builder.
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
              SourceImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ##########################################################################
  # Image pipelines (one per architecture, sharing infra + distribution)
  ##########################################################################

  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86_64'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication platform. Provisions an Amazon Cognito user pool on the
  PLUS tier with advanced security (threat protection) ENFORCED, email sign-in with admin-only user creation,
  custom guest/staff attributes, a strong password policy with email-based account recovery, a public SPA
  application client, a dedicated admin/automation client, six staff role groups bound to the pool, an API
  resource server exposing read/write/admin scopes, an OAuth2 machine-to-machine client using the
  client_credentials flow, and a user pool domain that publishes the OAuth2 token endpoint.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment for the AnyCompany Hotel authentication stack (dev, staging, prod).
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # User pool - AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff identity store
  ##############################################################################
  GuestStaffUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-guest-staff-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "64"
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "64"
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "64"

  ##############################################################################
  # Public SPA application client - SRP only, no secret
  ##############################################################################
  SpaAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  ##############################################################################
  # Dedicated admin/automation client - server-side harnesses and simulators
  ##############################################################################
  AdminAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  ##############################################################################
  # Staff role groups
  ##############################################################################
  AdminStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Full administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel platform administration.
      Precedence: 1

  RegionalManagerStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: Regional manager access across all properties in an AnyCompany Hotel region.
      Precedence: 2

  ManagerStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: Property manager access for a single AnyCompany Hotel property.
      Precedence: 3

  RevenueManagerStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: Revenue management access to rates, availability, and forecasting data.
      Precedence: 4

  FrontDeskStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: Front desk access for check-in, check-out, and guest stay management.
      Precedence: 5

  HousekeepingStaffGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: Housekeeping access for room status and cleaning task management.
      Precedence: 6

  ##############################################################################
  # Resource server - AnyCompany Hotel API with read/write/admin scopes
  ##############################################################################
  ApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      Identifier: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel API data and guest records.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to create and modify AnyCompany Hotel API records.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel API configuration and staff data.

  ##############################################################################
  # Machine-to-machine OAuth2 client - client_credentials flow with secret
  ##############################################################################
  MachineToMachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api/read"
        - !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api/write"
        - !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api/admin"
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours

  ##############################################################################
  # User pool domain - publishes the managed /oauth2 token endpoint
  ##############################################################################
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

Outputs:

  UserPoolId:
    Description: AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref GuestStaffUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool-id"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt GuestStaffUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool-arn"

  SpaAppClientId:
    Description: Public SPA application client ID (SRP auth, no client secret).
    Value: !Ref SpaAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client-id"

  AdminAppClientId:
    Description: Dedicated admin/automation client ID (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH).
    Value: !Ref AdminAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client-id"

  MachineToMachineClientId:
    Description: M2M OAuth2 client ID for the client_credentials flow (secret is not exported).
    Value: !Ref MachineToMachineClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client-id"

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the AnyCompany Hotel API resource server (prefixed to its scopes).
    Value: !Ref ApiResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-resource-server-identifier"

  UserPoolDomainPrefix:
    Description: User pool domain prefix containing the environment and account ID.
    Value: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-cognito-domain-prefix"

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Full Cognito user pool domain URL, including the OAuth2 token endpoint host.
    Value: !Sub "https://anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-cognito-domain-url"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights - prod Cognito stack. Creates an Amazon Cognito user pool with
  email sign-in, a custom last_login attribute maintained by a post-authentication
  Lambda trigger, the Admin/RegularUser/PowerUser groups, a hosted-UI domain prefix,
  and optional federated (OIDC/SAML) identity provider integration that stays disabled
  while SsoProviderName is empty.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operator note - federated client secret
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The IdpClientSecret resource is created by this template with a *generated* value so
# that no provider-issued secret ever appears in source control, in a parameter default,
# or in the rendered template. After the stack is created, the operator overwrites that
# generated placeholder with the client secret issued by the identity provider:
#
#   aws secretsmanager put-secret-value \
#     --secret-id <IdpClientSecret.Ref> \
#     --secret-string '<idp-issued-client-secret>'
#
# This in-place update is exactly why the secret is a template-owned resource referenced
# by ARN rather than an externally resolved secret name. The user pool identity provider
# is pointed at that ARN, so rotating or correcting the value never requires a template
# change. The secret is encrypted with the customer-managed KMS key created in this
# template (not the AWS-owned default key). Nothing else in the account needs to
# pre-exist.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Parameters:

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment. Used only for resource naming and tagging - it never
      references pre-existing infrastructure (nothing pre-exists in this account).

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start and end with a letter
      or number; maximum 63 characters.
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted-UI domain
      (https://<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com). Cognito domain prefixes are
      globally unique across all AWS accounts in a region, so if the deployment fails
      with an already-taken prefix, redeploy with a stack-name-qualified value such as
      hospitality-insights-prod-<unique suffix>.

  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/oauth2/callback
    Description: >-
      Allowed callback (redirect) URL for the hosted UI. Replace with the real
      application URL before enabling hosted-UI sign-in in production.

  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/
    Description: >-
      Allowed sign-out URL for the hosted UI. Replace with the real application URL
      before enabling hosted-UI sign-in in production.

  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated identity provider (for example "CorpOkta"). Leave empty
      (the default) to deploy Cognito-native authentication only - every SSO resource
      in this template is created only when a value is supplied.

  SsoProviderType:
    Type: String
    Default: OIDC
    AllowedValues:
      - OIDC
      - SAML
    Description: >-
      Federated identity provider protocol. Evaluated only when SsoProviderName is
      supplied.

  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      OIDC issuer URL (for example https://idp.example.com) or the SAML metadata URL
      of the federated identity provider. Required when SsoProviderName is supplied.

  SsoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Client ID issued by the federated identity provider (OIDC client_id).
      Required when SsoProviderName is supplied.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conditions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Conditions:

  # SSO resources exist only when an identity provider name is supplied.
  IsSsoEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]

  # Inverse of IsSsoEnabled, used to publish the effective sign-in mode.
  IsSsoDisabled: !Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']

  # Selects the correct ProviderDetails shape for the configured protocol.
  IsOidcProvider: !Equals [!Ref SsoProviderType, OIDC]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Resources
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Resources:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User pool - holds stateful identity data, therefore Retain on delete and replace.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-user-pool'
      # Users sign in with their e-mail address, which is also the verified contact.
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      # MfaConfiguration and EnabledMfas are a matched pair: any value other than OFF
      # requires at least one EnabledMfas entry, otherwise the pool create is rejected
      # with "Define at least one MFA configuration". OPTIONAL therefore means "TOTP is
      # available to users who enroll it", not "MFA enabled but undefined". Only
      # SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA (TOTP) is listed: SMS_MFA requires an SmsConfiguration (SNS
      # sender plus IAM role) that this greenfield stack deliberately does not create.
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      # Custom attribute written by the post-authentication trigger. Lambda and
      # application code must address it as "custom:last_login" - Cognito requires the
      # custom: prefix in API calls, while the Schema name omits it.
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      # The reference to the trigger function creates the required implicit dependency;
      # no DependsOn is needed (and Amazon Cognito must invoke the function directly,
      # so the function is deliberately not placed in a VPC).
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      # NOTE: no EmailConfiguration is set, so Amazon Cognito uses its built-in e-mail
      # sender (50 messages/day). Attach verified SES credentials for production
      # volumes once a sending domain exists.
      # NOTE: AWS::Cognito::UserPool takes tags as a map via UserPoolTags, unlike the
      # list-of-Key/Value form used by the Lambda, IAM role and secret resources here.
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web application client - public client (SPA/mobile), 24 hour session timeout.
  # MFA factor enablement is a pool-level attribute, so nothing on this client changes.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      # 24 hour session timeout. AuthSessionValidity is capped at 3-15 minutes and can
      # therefore never express a 24 hour session - refresh token validity is the
      # correct property for this requirement.
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: hours
      # Explicit read/write scoping, including the custom attribute used by the trigger.
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:last_login
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:last_login
      # COGNITO is always offered; the federated provider is appended only when SSO is on.
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - IsSsoEnabled
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SsoProviderName
        - - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups - lower Precedence value means higher priority.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Hospitality Insights administrators (highest priority).
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Hospitality Insights standard users.
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Hospitality Insights power users (lowest priority of the three).
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain.
  # CustomDomainConfig is intentionally not used: it requires an ACM certificate and a
  # Route 53 record for a domain this greenfield account does not own.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-authentication trigger.
  # The user pool ID is taken from the event at runtime, never from an environment
  # variable or resource attribute, so the function does not depend on the user pool.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-cognito-post-authentication'
      Description: >-
        Cognito PostAuthentication trigger that stamps the mutable custom:last_login
        attribute with the current UTC timestamp.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthFunctionRole.Arn
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      # Active (not PassThrough) so that the function publishes X-Ray segments.
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime
          import logging

          import boto3

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          COGNITO_IDP = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE = "custom:last_login"


          def _utc_now_iso8601():
              return (
                  datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                  .replace(microsecond=0)
                  .isoformat()
                  .replace("+00:00", "Z")
              )


          def handler(event, context):
              """Cognito PostAuthentication trigger.

              Records the sign-in time in the mutable custom:last_login attribute of
              the authenticating user. Any failure is logged and swallowed so that
              authentication is never blocked by an attribute update error.
              """
              try:
                  user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
                  user_name = event["userName"]
                  COGNITO_IDP.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, "Value": _utc_now_iso8601()}
                      ],
                  )
                  LOGGER.info("Updated %s for user %s", LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, user_name)
              except Exception:
                  LOGGER.exception(
                      "Could not update %s; continuing with authentication.",
                      LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE,
                  )
              return event

  PostAuthFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito post-authentication trigger.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        # AWS managed policy ARNs are account agnostic and safe as literals. X-Ray
        # write access is required because TracingConfig is Active.
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: update-custom-last-login
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                # Partition/region/account are resolved at deploy time. The literal
                # pool wildcard is used instead of the user pool ARN so that the
                # function's role never depends on the user pool that depends on the
                # function.
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      # Only this user pool, in this account, may invoke the trigger.
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional federated identity provider (created only when SsoProviderName is set).
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Customer-managed KMS key for the SSO client secret. Created inside this template
  # because the account is greenfield; the secret and the alias that reference it carry
  # the same IsSsoEnabled condition so no orphaned key exists when SSO is disabled.
  IdpSecretKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer-managed key encrypting the Hospitality Insights federated identity
        provider client secret.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # Root access is required so IAM identity-based policies and the
          # CloudFormation service role can delegate use of this key.
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          # Allows Secrets Manager to encrypt/decrypt on behalf of callers in this
          # region only.
          - Sid: AllowSecretsManagerViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: secretsmanager.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  IdpSecretKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/hospitality-insights-${Environment}-sso-client-secret'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref IdpSecretKey

  IdpClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-sso-client-secret'
      Description: >-
        Client secret for the federated identity provider. The template generates a
        placeholder value; the operator overwrites it in place with the IdP-issued
        secret after the stack is created, so no provider secret is ever stored in the
        template or passed in as a parameter. The identity provider below references
        this secret by ARN, so correcting or rotating the value needs no template change.
      # Encrypted with the customer-managed key defined above, not the AWS-owned
      # default Secrets Manager key.
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt IdpSecretKey.Arn
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{}'
        GenerateStringKey: client_secret
        PasswordLength: 64
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: !Ref SsoProviderType
      IdpIdentifiers:
        - !Ref SsoProviderName
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        username: sub
      ProviderDetails: !If
        - IsOidcProvider
        - client_id: !Ref SsoClientId
          # !Ref on a Secrets Manager secret returns its ARN; never a plain-text value
          # and never an externally resolved secret name.
          client_secret: !Ref IdpClientSecret
          attributes_request_method: GET
          oidc_issuer: !Ref SsoLoginUrl
          authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        - MetadataURL: !Ref SsoLoginUrl

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the web application user pool client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUiDomain:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI for this user pool.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  HostedUiLoginUrl:
    Description: >-
      Hosted UI sign-in URL. COGNITO is always offered; the federated provider appears
      in this flow only when SSO is enabled.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=email+openid+profile&redirect_uri=${CallbackUrl}'

  SsoProviderName:
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated identity provider configured for the hosted UI (emitted
      only when SSO is enabled).
    Value: !Ref SsoProviderName

  SsoClientSecretArn:
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Description: >-
      ARN of the Secrets Manager secret that holds the federated client secret. The
      generated placeholder must be overwritten with the IdP-issued value after deploy.
    Value: !Ref IdpClientSecret

  SsoClientSecretKmsKeyArn:
    Condition: IsSsoEnabled
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key that encrypts the SSO client secret.
    Value: !GetAtt IdpSecretKey.Arn

  SignInMode:
    Condition: IsSsoDisabled
    Description: >-
      Confirms that this deployment authenticates users with COGNITO only, because no
      federated identity provider was supplied.
    Value: COGNITO_ONLY
