final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover monitoring of
  pre-existing application resources: an existing API Gateway API (Remittance),
  two existing Lambda functions (GetRemittances, CreateRemittance), and an
  existing RDS instance (dbcluster1-instance1). This template creates ONLY
  CloudWatch alarm resources (3 composite alarms plus their underlying metric
  alarms) and no compute, network, data, IAM, or storage resources. The target
  resources are referenced read-only through CloudWatch metric namespaces and
  dimensions.

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: >-
      Name of the pre-existing API Gateway API. Used as the ApiName dimension
      for the AWS/ApiGateway alarms.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: >-
      Name of the pre-existing GetRemittances Lambda function. Used as the
      FunctionName dimension for the AWS/Lambda alarms.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: >-
      Name of the pre-existing CreateRemittance Lambda function. Used as the
      FunctionName dimension for the AWS/Lambda alarms.
  DbInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: >-
      Identifier of the pre-existing RDS instance. Used as the
      DBInstanceIdentifier dimension for the AWS/RDS alarms.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # API Gateway underlying alarms (AWS/ApiGateway)
  ############################################################################

  ApiGateway4xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'API Gateway 4XX Errors'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average 4XX errors for the API Gateway API are above 0 over a 300
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'API Gateway 5XX Errors'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average 5XX errors for the API Gateway API are above 1 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'API Gateway Latency'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average latency for the API Gateway API is at or above 10000 ms over a
        300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ############################################################################
  # Lambda underlying alarms (AWS/Lambda)
  ############################################################################

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'GetRemittances Lambda Errors'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Summed errors for the GetRemittances Lambda function exceed 0 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'CreateRemittance Lambda Errors'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Summed errors for the CreateRemittance Lambda function exceed 0 over a
        60 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # NOTE: The Invocations alarms below are standalone monitors created as
  # requested. The requirement explicitly states that the 'Lambda Health'
  # composite alarm rule references only the Errors and Duration alarms, so
  # these Invocations alarms are intentionally NOT members of that AlarmRule.

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'GetRemittances Lambda Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Summed invocations for the GetRemittances Lambda function exceed 2 over
        a 60 second period. Standalone monitor, not part of the Lambda Health
        composite alarm.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'CreateRemittance Lambda Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Summed invocations for the CreateRemittance Lambda function exceed 2
        over a 60 second period. Standalone monitor, not part of the Lambda
        Health composite alarm.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # NOTE: Duration alarms use TreatMissingData 'missing' (deliberately not
  # 'notBreaching') as required for the duration metrics only.

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'GetRemittances Lambda Duration'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average duration for the GetRemittances Lambda function is at or above
        10000 ms over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'CreateRemittance Lambda Duration'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average duration for the CreateRemittance Lambda function is at or
        above 10000 ms over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  ############################################################################
  # RDS underlying alarms (AWS/RDS)
  #
  # NOTE: TreatMissingData is intentionally omitted on every RDS alarm below so
  # that CloudWatch's standard default treatment applies.
  #
  # NOTE (uncertainty): The AWS/RDS 'Queries' metric is only emitted by
  # Aurora / Performance Insights-enabled engines. If the target instance does
  # not emit it, the alarm will sit in INSUFFICIENT_DATA, which matches the
  # requested behaviour of leaving TreatMissingData unset, so no change is
  # required.
  ############################################################################

  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS CPU Utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average CPU utilization for the RDS instance is at or above 70 percent
        over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Database Connections'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average database connections for the RDS instance are at or above 100
        over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Deadlocks'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average deadlocks for the RDS instance are at or above 10 over a 300
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Network Transmit Throughput'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average network transmit throughput for the RDS instance is at or above
        10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Network Receive Throughput'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average network receive throughput for the RDS instance is at or above
        10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Queries'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average queries for the RDS instance are at or above 100 over a 300
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Disk Queue Depth'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average disk queue depth for the RDS instance is at or above 50 over a
        300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Read Latency'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average read latency for the RDS instance is at or above 0.1 seconds
        over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Write Latency'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Average write latency for the RDS instance is at or above 0.1 seconds
        over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  ############################################################################
  # Composite alarms
  #
  # Composite AlarmRule expressions use the ALARM(arn) function form with the
  # uppercase OR operator, referencing member alarms via Fn::Sub with
  # ${LogicalId} placeholders. !Ref on an AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm returns its
  # ARN. Implicit dependencies from these references create the required
  # ordering, so no DependsOn is added (avoiding circular references).
  ############################################################################

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'API Gateway Health'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite alarm that trips when ANY API Gateway underlying alarm
        (4XX errors, 5XX errors, or latency) is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${ApiGateway4xxAlarm}) OR ALARM(${ApiGateway5xxAlarm}) OR ALARM(${ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm})'

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'Lambda Health'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite alarm that trips when ANY Lambda Errors or Duration alarm
        (GetRemittances or CreateRemittance) is in ALARM. The Lambda Invocations
        alarms are intentionally excluded from this rule per the requirement.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}) OR ALARM(${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}) OR ALARM(${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}) OR ALARM(${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm})'

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: 'RDS Health'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite alarm that trips when ANY RDS underlying alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsDeadlocksAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsQueriesAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsReadLatencyAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm})'

Outputs:

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmName'

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmArn'

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmName'

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn'

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref RdsHealthCompositeAlarm
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RdsHealthCompositeAlarmName'

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RdsHealthCompositeAlarmArn'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin-suite monitoring and data-extraction pipeline. Creates a
  KMS-encrypted private output S3 bucket, a KMS-encrypted script S3 bucket, a
  dedicated SSE-S3 access-log bucket, a customer managed KMS key, a shared IAM
  role assumable by Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose and CloudWatch metric
  streams, seven scheduled AWS Glue jobs (five Python shell 3.9 / Glue 3.0 and
  two Spark ETL G.1X / Glue 5.0), five CloudWatch metric streams with JSON
  output, and five DirectPut Kinesis Firehose delivery streams that persist
  metrics into the output bucket.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key for bucket encryption
  ###########################################################################
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the QuickSight admin-suite buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/admin-suite-pipeline-${AWS::AccountId}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  ###########################################################################
  # Dedicated SSE-S3 access-log bucket (must NOT be KMS encrypted)
  ###########################################################################
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-logs-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAccessLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "admin-suite-logs-${AWS::AccountId}"
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite-access-logs

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}"
                  - !Sub "${ScriptBucket.Arn}"
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  ###########################################################################
  # Output bucket (admin-suite-<accountId>) - data retention + private
  ###########################################################################
  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: output-bucket/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite-monitoring-output

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousReadAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - "s3:GetObject"
              - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
              - "s3:ListBucket"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: Anonymous

  ###########################################################################
  # Script bucket (greenfield replacement for the predefined script bucket)
  ###########################################################################
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: script-bucket/
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}"
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite-glue-scripts

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousReadAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - "s3:GetObject"
              - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
              - "s3:ListBucket"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: Anonymous

  ###########################################################################
  # Shared IAM role for Glue / CloudFormation / Firehose / Metric Streams
  ###########################################################################
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-pipeline-role-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Shared execution role for the QuickSight admin-suite monitoring pipeline.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPipelineServicesToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: quicksight-read-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "quicksight:Describe*"
                  - "quicksight:List*"
                  - "quicksight:Get*"
                  - "quicksight:Search*"
                  - "quicksight:DescribeAccountSettings"
                  - "quicksight:DescribeAccountSubscription"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

        - PolicyName: glue-job-and-trigger-management
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueJobTriggerManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "glue:CreateJob"
                  - "glue:UpdateJob"
                  - "glue:DeleteJob"
                  - "glue:GetJob"
                  - "glue:GetJobs"
                  - "glue:GetJobRun"
                  - "glue:GetJobRuns"
                  - "glue:StartJobRun"
                  - "glue:BatchStopJobRun"
                  - "glue:CreateTrigger"
                  - "glue:UpdateTrigger"
                  - "glue:DeleteTrigger"
                  - "glue:GetTrigger"
                  - "glue:GetTriggers"
                  - "glue:StartTrigger"
                  - "glue:StopTrigger"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/*"
              - Sid: GlueCatalogRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "glue:GetDatabase"
                  - "glue:GetDatabases"
                  - "glue:GetTable"
                  - "glue:GetTables"
                  - "glue:GetPartition"
                  - "glue:GetPartitions"
                  - "glue:GetConnection"
                  - "glue:GetConnections"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:connection/*"

        - PolicyName: s3-script-read-output-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListScriptBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadScriptObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  - "s3:GetObjectAttributes"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ListOutputBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - Sid: WriteAndReadOutputObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  - "s3:DeleteObject"
                  - "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
                  - "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}/*"

        - PolicyName: cloudwatch-metrics-and-streams
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutMetricData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudwatch:PutMetricData"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: MetricStreamManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudwatch:PutMetricStream"
                  - "cloudwatch:GetMetricStream"
                  - "cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams"
                  - "cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream"
                  - "cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams"
                  - "cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams"
                  - "cloudwatch:TagResource"
                  - "cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:metric-stream/*"

        - PolicyName: firehose-delivery-management
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: FirehoseCreateAccountScoped
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "firehose:CreateDeliveryStream"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: FirehoseDeliveryManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream"
                  - "firehose:ListDeliveryStreams"
                  - "firehose:UpdateDestination"
                  - "firehose:PutRecord"
                  - "firehose:PutRecordBatch"
                  - "firehose:TagDeliveryStream"
                  - "firehose:ListTagsForDeliveryStream"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*"

        - PolicyName: cloudwatch-logs-for-pipeline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueAndFirehoseLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/*"

        - PolicyName: kms-bucket-encryption
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseAdminSuiteKmsKeyForBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  ###########################################################################
  # Five Python shell Glue jobs (Python 3.9 / Glue 3.0)
  ###########################################################################
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collect QuickSight asset access details (Python shell).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "assets-access/"

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Collect QuickSight asset metadata (Python shell).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "assets-metadata/"

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Collect QuickSight folder structure information (Python shell).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "folder-assets/"

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Collect QuickSight Q topic metadata (Python shell).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "q-metadata/"

  QAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Collect QuickSight Q object access details (Python shell).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "q-access/"

  ###########################################################################
  # Two Spark ETL Glue jobs (Glue 5.0 / G.1X / 2 workers)
  ###########################################################################
  DatasetPropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Extract QuickSight dataset properties (Spark ETL).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "ds-properties/"

  DataSourcePropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Extract QuickSight data source properties (Spark ETL).
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref OutputBucket
        "--OUTPUT_PREFIX": "datasource-properties/"

  ###########################################################################
  # Seven scheduled Glue triggers (every 3 hours)
  ###########################################################################
  AssetsAccessJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsAccessJob

  AssetsMetadataJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsMetadataJob

  FolderAssetsJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  QMetadataJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QMetadataJob

  QAccessJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QAccessJob

  DatasetPropertiesJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasetPropertiesJob

  DataSourcePropertiesJobScheduledTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties_scheduled
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DataSourcePropertiesJob

  ###########################################################################
  # Five DirectPut Firehose delivery streams (one per metric stream)
  ###########################################################################
  IngestionFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: ingestion/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: ingestion-errors/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  VisualLoadFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-visual-load-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: visual-load/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: visual-load-errors/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  SpiceFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-spice-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

        Prefix: spice/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: spice-errors/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  QuickIndexFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quick-index-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: quick-index/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: quick-index-errors/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  ActionsFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-actions-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: actions/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: actions-errors/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn

  ###########################################################################
  # Five CloudWatch metric streams (JSON output, Firehose destination)
  ###########################################################################
  IngestionMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt IngestionFirehoseStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: "AWS/QuickSight"
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics

  VisualLoadMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-visual-load-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt VisualLoadFirehoseStream.Arn

          Value: admin-suite-visual-load-metrics

  SpiceMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:

      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt SpiceFirehoseStream.Arn

  QuickIndexMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quick-index-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt QuickIndexFirehoseStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  IAM identities, instance profiles, and permission policies required by the
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for an Amazon EKS cluster.
  Everything is defined inline for a greenfield account; no external resources.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM Roles
  ##############################################################################

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane'
      Description: CAPA control plane IAM role assumed by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CAPA-ControlPlane

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes'
      Description: CAPA worker node IAM role assumed by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CAPA-Nodes

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers'
      Description: >-
        CAPA controllers IAM role assumable by EC2 instance profiles and by
        EKS pods (via the EKS service principal).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: EKSPodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CAPA-Controllers

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane'
      Description: EKS control plane service role used by the Amazon EKS service
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EKS-ControlPlane

  ##############################################################################
  # Instance Profiles
  ##############################################################################

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ##############################################################################
  # Customer managed policies
  ##############################################################################

  # 8. Legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider permissions (control plane only)
  LegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-legacy-cloud-provider'
      Description: >-
        Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider running on the
        control plane (EC2, Auto Scaling, ELB/ELBv2, KMS).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2ReadAndLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingClassic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeInstanceHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicyTypes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DisableAvailabilityZonesForLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:EnableAvailabilityZonesForLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingV2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeSSLPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetRulePriorities
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # 9. Node registration & image pull policy (control plane + nodes)
  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-node-registration'
      Description: >-
        Permissions that let cluster nodes register with the cluster and pull
        container images (EC2 metadata, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL stack. Provisions a dedicated IAM service role for
  AWS Glue and an AWS Glue 4.0 (Spark) ETL job that converts Shapefiles into individual
  GeoJSON files. The template is fully self-contained and deployable unattended in a
  greenfield account: it creates the IAM role and the Glue job, and references the S3
  buckets and ETL script by name only.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE (external resources - objective 16):
# The S3 buckets "map-appraiser-data-raw-gis", "map-appraiser-glue-scripts" and
# "map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base", as well as the ETL script object referenced by the
# GlueScriptLocation parameter, are EXTERNAL to this template and are referenced by name
# only. No bucket ARNs, account IDs, VPC/subnet/security-group IDs or AMI IDs are invented
# or hardcoded anywhere in this template. All ARNs are composed at deploy time with
# pseudo-parameters (!Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:...).
#
# NOTE (no secrets - objective 17):
# This template contains no secrets, no plaintext credentials, and no
# {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}} / {{resolve:ssm:...}} / {{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}
# dynamic references. If credentials were later required, an AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
# resource with GenerateSecretString would have to be created inside this same template.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job that converts Shapefiles to individual GeoJSON files.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: S3 URI of the Glue ETL Python script (must be an s3:// URI).
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://[a-z0-9.\-]+/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 URI of the form s3://bucket/key.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the AWS Glue ETL job.

Resources:

  # IAM service role assumed by AWS Glue. Grants the AWS-managed AWSGlueServiceRole policy
  # plus inline policies for CloudWatch Logs and scoped S3 access.
  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON AWS Glue ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        # AWS-managed policy ARN (the only static ARN permitted in this template).
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        # Full CloudWatch Logs access for Glue job/driver/executor logs.
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:AssociateKmsKey
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'
        # Scoped read-only access to the raw GIS input bucket and the scripts bucket.
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadRawAndScripts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListRawAndScriptsBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts'
              - Sid: ReadRawAndScriptsObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/*'
        # Read/write access to the knowledge-base output bucket.
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadWriteKnowledgeBase
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListKnowledgeBaseBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base'
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base/*'

  # AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job.
  # The role reference (!GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn) creates an implicit dependency on the
  # IAM role, so no redundant DependsOn is declared.
  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Converts Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files using AWS Glue 4.0 (Spark).
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        # Observability / continuous logging.
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/'
        # Job state and execution environment.
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--TempDir': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas0.14.1,shapely2.0.2,pyproj3.6.1,fiona1.9.5'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE (schema-uncertain properties - objective 18):
# Only documented AWS::Glue::Job properties are used above. The DefaultArguments keys
# (--enable-metrics, --enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log, --enable-continuous-log-filter,
# --spark-event-logs-path, --job-bookmark-option, --TempDir, --additional-python-modules)
# are passed through as plain string key/value pairs, which is the supported mechanism for
# Glue job arguments; any argument not understood by the Glue runtime is ignored rather
# than causing a schema/parse failure. No unsupported top-level properties have been
# invented or omitted intentionally.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Outputs:

  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueJobName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobName'

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by the AWS Glue ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the AWS Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleName'

  GlueScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: >-
      Command the operator/CI must run to upload the ETL script to the parameterized S3
      location before the Glue job can execute successfully.
    Value: !Sub 'aws s3 cp ./shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py ${GlueScriptLocation}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueScriptUploadCommand'
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-7e4903b5' on localstack", 'iac-god-eval-7e4903b5: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'GlueServiceRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'GlueServiceRole: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'iac-god-eval-7e4903b5: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']
deploy_completed_resources: GlueServiceRole | ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated daily enforcement of account-level S3 Block Public Access using
  AWS Systems Manager Automation and Amazon EventBridge.
Parameters:
  DocumentName:
    Type: String
    Default: S3AccountBlockPublicAccess
    Description: >-
      Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces account-level
      S3 Block Public Access.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 day)
    Description: >-
      EventBridge schedule expression (rate or cron) that triggers the
      S3 Block Public Access enforcement automation.
    MinLength: 1
Resources:
  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation to enforce
        account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAccountLevelS3PublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
  S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DocumentName
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access by invoking the
          S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API with BlockPublicAcls,
          BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls, and RestrictPublicBuckets set
          to true for the local account.
        assumeRole: '{{automationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          automationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              ARN of the IAM role that the Automation assumes to call the
              S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableAccountLevelBlockPublicAccess
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            isEnd: true
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by Amazon EventBridge to start the S3 Block Public Access
        SSM Automation execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
