final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the Service Catalog preventive-control test environment: a VPC using 172.16.0.0/16 with
  DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled, two subnets in the first two Availability Zones of the
  region, a test security group, a customer managed KMS key and alias whose key policy grants the
  Service Catalog launch roles, the DMS service role named dms-vpc-role and a DMS replication subnet
  group, an ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group, a SageMaker execution role, and one
  Service Catalog launch role per product type.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    Description: >-
      Name used to prefix and tag every resource created by this test stack (for example, "test").

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Network
  ##############################################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Egress is deliberately restricted to the VPC's own IPv4 CIDR (resolved from
  # the VPC created in this template) rather than 0.0.0.0/0, so the test
  # resources can only reach the network this stack owns.
  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Security group for the Service Catalog preventive-control test resources (${EnvironmentName})'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow egress only within the test VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-test-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # VPC flow logs (CloudWatch Logs destination)
  ##############################################################################

  # The log group is intentionally left at default stack deletion behavior (no
  # Retain policy): it holds only ephemeral flow-log data for the test stack.
  # It is encrypted with the customer managed key created in this template; the
  # key policy below grants the CloudWatch Logs service principal the actions
  # needed to use it. No aws:SourceArn condition is used on that grant, because
  # this log group already depends on the key and a back-reference would create
  # a circular dependency.
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt TestKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: Delivery role that VPC Flow Logs assumes to publish records to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: REJECT
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key
  ##############################################################################

  TestKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${EnvironmentName} Service Catalog preventive-control test environment'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunchRolesUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleApplicationLoadBalancer.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAutoScaling.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDms.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDynamoDb.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEbs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEfs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElastiCache.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleOpenSearch.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleFSx.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleKinesis.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSns.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSqs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSageMaker.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleS3.Arn
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TestKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestKmsKey

  ##############################################################################
  # DMS service role and replication subnet group
  ##############################################################################

  # DMS looks this role up by the literal name "dms-vpc-role" before a
  # replication subnet group can be created, so the name is intentionally fixed.
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Service role that AWS DMS assumes to manage VPC resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: !Sub 'DMS replication subnet group for ${EnvironmentName}'
      ReplicationSubnetGroupIdentifier: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-dms-subnet-group'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group
  ##############################################################################

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-elasticache-subnet-group'
      Description: !Sub 'ElastiCache subnet group for ${EnvironmentName}'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'ElastiCache cache security group for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-elasticache-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # SageMaker execution role
  ##############################################################################

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-sagemaker-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role assumed by Amazon SageMaker.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ##############################################################################
  # Service Catalog launch roles (one per product type)
  ##############################################################################

  LaunchRoleApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-alb'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for application load balancers, listeners and target groups.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleAutoScaling:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-autoscaling'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Auto Scaling resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleDms:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-dms'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DMS endpoints and replication instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsLaunchPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'dms:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassDmsServiceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt DmsVpcRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleDynamoDb:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-dynamodb'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DynamoDB resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleEbs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-ebs'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for EBS volumes and snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleEfs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-efs'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Amazon EFS resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleElastiCache:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-elasticache'

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElastiCacheFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LaunchRoleOpenSearch:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-opensearch'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Amazon Elasticsearch / OpenSearch Service resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonOpenSearchServiceFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy

  LaunchRoleFSx:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-fsx'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Amazon FSx resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonFSxFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy

  LaunchRoleKinesis:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-kinesis'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Amazon Kinesis resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonKinesisFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy

  LaunchRoleSns:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-launch-role-sns'

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSNSFullAccess

  LaunchRoleSqs:

      ManagedPolicyArns:

        - Key: ManagedBy

  LaunchRoleSageMaker:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  LaunchRoleS3:

          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy

##############################################################################
# Outputs consumed by the preventive-control test harness
##############################################################################

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the test VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  Subnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first test subnet (172.16.1.0/24).
    Value: !Ref TestSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet1Id'

  Subnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second test subnet (172.16.2.0/24).
    Value: !Ref TestSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet2Id'

  TestSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group used by the test resources.
    Value: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TestSecurityGroupId'

  VpcFlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log attached to the test VPC.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogId'

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:

    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'

  FlowLogsRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsRoleArn'

  KmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref TestKmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId'

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt TestKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref TestKmsKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAlias'

  DmsVpcRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DMS service role named dms-vpc-role.
    Value: !GetAtt DmsVpcRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DmsVpcRoleArn'

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroupId:
    Description: Identifier of the DMS replication subnet group.
    Value: !Ref DmsReplicationSubnetGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DmsReplicationSubnetGroupId'

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroupName:
    Description: Name of the ElastiCache subnet group.
    Value: !Ref ElastiCacheSubnetGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ElastiCacheSubnetGroupName'

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroupName:
    Description: Name of the ElastiCache cache security group.
    Value: !Ref ElastiCacheSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ElastiCacheSecurityGroupName'

  SageMakerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SageMakerExecutionRoleArn'

  LaunchRoleApplicationLoadBalancerArn:
    Description: ARN of the application load balancer / listener / target group launch role.
    Value: !GetAtt LaunchRoleApplicationLoadBalancer.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LaunchRoleApplicationLoadBalancerArn'

  LaunchRoleAutoScalingArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform.

Parameters:
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
  SenderPhoneNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: "+10000000000"
  WhatsAppSenderId:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-whatsapp-sender
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  CampaignAssetsBucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-assets
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-orchestrator
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'

Conditions:
  EnableSemanticSearch: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Resources:

  CampaignDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'}
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com, dynamodb.amazonaws.com, s3.amazonaws.com, sns.amazonaws.com, states.amazonaws.com, aoss.amazonaws.com]
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LogsUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'}
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  CampaignDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignDataKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: profileType, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: profileType, KeyType: RANGE}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-channel-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: channel, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: window, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: channel, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: window, KeyType: RANGE}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  MessageDeliveryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-message-delivery'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: messageId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: messageId, KeyType: HASH}
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: campaignId-index
          KeySchema:
            - {AttributeName: campaignId, KeyType: HASH}
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  CampaignAssetsLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - {ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: {SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms, KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrent
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}

  CampaignAssetsLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com}
            Action: [s3:PutObject]
            Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsLogBucket.Arn}/campaign-assets/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals: {aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'}
              ArnLike: {aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucketNamePrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: {SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms, KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref CampaignAssetsLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: campaign-assets/
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrent
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}

  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: [s3:PutObject]
            Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals: {s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms}
          - Sid: AllowCampaignLambdas
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {AWS: [!GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn]}
            Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket]
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'

  OrchestrationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-orchestration'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/apigateway/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-api'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  DeliveryStatusTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-delivery-status'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  PipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pipeline'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Pipeline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [bedrock:InvokeModel, bedrock:ApplyGuardrail], Resource: ['arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/*', !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:guardrail/*']}
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [ses:SendEmail, ses:SendRawEmail], Resource: '*'}
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [sns:Publish], Resource: [!Ref DeliveryStatusTopic, !Ref AlertTopic]}
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}

  LauncherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-launcher'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Launch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [states:StartExecution], Resource: !Ref CampaignStateMachine}
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}

  StatusRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-status'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Status
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}

  CallbackRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-delivery-status-callback'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Callback
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MessageDeliveryTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}

  SemanticSearchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-semantic-search'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Vector
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [aoss:APIAccessAll, aoss:DashboardsAccessAll], Resource: !GetAtt SemanticSearchCollection.Arn}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [bedrock:InvokeModel]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey], Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-campaign-orchestration'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - {Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: states.amazonaws.com}, Action: sts:AssumeRole}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Orchestrate
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [lambda:InvokeFunction], Resource: !GetAtt PipelineFunction.Arn}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogDelivery, logs:GetLogDelivery, logs:UpdateLogDelivery, logs:DeleteLogDelivery, logs:ListLogDeliveries, logs:PutResourcePolicy, logs:DescribeResourcePolicies, logs:DescribeLogGroups]
                Resource: '*'
              - {Effect: Allow, Action: [xray:PutTraceSegments, xray:PutTelemetryRecords, xray:GetSamplingRules, xray:GetSamplingTargets], Resource: '*'}

  PipelineFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pipeline'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 900
      TracingConfig: {Mode: Active}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTable
          DELIVERY_STATUS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref DeliveryStatusTopic
          ALERT_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic
          SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
          SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER: !Ref SenderPhoneNumber
          WHATSAPP_SENDER_ID: !Ref WhatsAppSenderId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,time,uuid,re,boto3
          dy=boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          bed=boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          ses=boto3.client("ses")
          sns=boto3.client("sns")
          MID=os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"]
          PROFILES=dy.Table(os.environ["CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE"])
          LIMITS=dy.Table(os.environ["CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE"])
          DELIV=dy.Table(os.environ["MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TABLE"])
          CH=["email","sms","push","whatsapp"]
          BLOCKED=["guaranteed cure","get rich quick","no risk","miracle treatment"]
          G={"email":"Write the email version. First line is the subject prefixed with 'Subject:', then a body of at most 150 words.","sms":"Write the SMS version in at most 160 characters with a short call to action.","push":"Write the push notification version in at most 120 characters with no links.","whatsapp":"Write the WhatsApp version, conversational, at most 300 characters, no emoji."}
          def _txt(r):
              p=json.loads(r["body"].read())
              return "".join(b.get("text","") for b in p.get("content",[]) if b.get("type")=="text")
          def _gen(prompt):
              body={"anthropic_version":"bedrock-2023-05-31","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":prompt}]}
              return _txt(bed.invoke_model(modelId=MID,body=json.dumps(body)))
          def parse(p):
              ins=p.get("instruction","")
              pr="Instruction: "+ins+"\n\nReturn JSON with keys objective, tone, channels (list of email,sms,push,whatsapp), audience (object with criteria), keyMessages (list of strings)."
              body={"anthropic_version":"bedrock-2023-05-31","max_tokens":1024,"system":"You are a marketing campaign planner. Respond with JSON only.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":pr}]}
              t=_txt(bed.invoke_model(modelId=MID,body=json.dumps(body)))
              m=re.search(r"\{.*\}",t,re.DOTALL)
              plan={}
              if m:
                  try:plan=json.loads(m.group(0))
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:plan={}
              if not plan:plan={"objective":ins,"tone":"professional","channels":["email"],"audience":{"criteria":"all consented customers"},"keyMessages":[ins]}
              plan.setdefault("channels",["email"]);plan.setdefault("keyMessages",[ins])
              p["plan"]=plan
              return p
          def segment(p):
              items=[];kw={}
              while True:
                  r=PROFILES.scan(**kw);items.extend(r.get("Items",[]))
                  k=r.get("LastEvaluatedKey")
                  if not k:break
                  kw["ExclusiveStartKey"]=k
              seg=[]
              for i in items:
                  if i.get("consent","granted")!="granted":continue
                  seg.append({"customerId":i.get("customerId"),"email":i.get("email",""),"phone":i.get("phone",""),"pushToken":i.get("pushToken",""),"whatsappId":i.get("whatsappId",""),"preferredChannels":i.get("preferredChannels",[])})
              p["segment"]=seg;p["segmentSize"]=len(seg)
              return p
          def predict(p):
              lim={}
              for i in LIMITS.scan().get("Items",[]):
                  if i.get("channel"):lim[i["channel"]]=int(i.get("limit",1000))
              c={};tg=[]
              for x in p.get("segment",[]):
                  a={"email":x.get("email",""),"sms":x.get("phone",""),"push":x.get("pushToken",""),"whatsapp":x.get("whatsappId","")}
                  pref=list(x.get("preferredChannels") or [])
                  for ch in pref+[y for y in CH if y not in pref]:
                      if ch not in CH or not a.get(ch):continue
                      if c.get(ch,0)>=lim.get(ch,1000):continue
                      c[ch]=c.get(ch,0)+1
                      tg.append({"customerId":x.get("customerId"),"channel":ch,"address":a[ch]})
                      break
              p["targets"]=tg;p["channelCounts"]=c
              return p
          def safety(p):
              pl=p.get("plan",{})
              pr="Write the primary marketing message below. No medical, financial or legal guarantees. Plain text only.\n\nObjective: "+str(pl.get("objective",""))+"\nTone: "+str(pl.get("tone","professional"))+"\nKey messages: "+"; ".join(pl.get("keyMessages",[]))
              t=_gen(pr)
              v=[b for b in BLOCKED if b in t.lower()]
              if v:raise ValueError("Content safety check failed: "+", ".join(v))
              p["content"]={"base":t}
              return p
          def adapt(p):
              base=p.get("content",{}).get("base","")
              obj=str(p.get("plan",{}).get("objective",""))
              ad={}
              for ch in sorted({t.get("channel") for t in p.get("targets",[]) if t.get("channel")}):
                  ad[ch]=_gen("You are a channel copywriter. "+G.get(ch,"Rewrite for a generic channel.")+"\nCampaign objective: "+obj+"\nBase message: "+base+"\nReturn only the rewritten message.").strip()
              p["adaptedContent"]=ad
              return p
          def deliver(p):
              cid=p["campaignId"];ad=p.get("adaptedContent",{});res=[]
              for x in p.get("targets",[]):
                  ch=x.get("channel");addr=x.get("address") or "";mid=str(uuid.uuid4())
                  body=ad.get(ch) or ad.get("email","");st="SENT";dt=""
                  try:
                      if ch=="email":
                          lines=body.splitlines();sub="Campaign message"
                          if lines and lines[0].lower().startswith("subject:"):
                              sub=lines[0].split(":",1)[1].strip() or sub
                              body="\n".join(lines[1:]).strip()
                          ses.send_email(Source=os.environ["SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS"],Destination={"ToAddresses":[addr or os.environ["SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS"]]},Message={"Subject":{"Data":sub[:120]},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":body}}})
                      elif ch=="sms":
                          sns.publish(PhoneNumber=addr or os.environ["SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER"],Message=body)
                      elif ch=="whatsapp":
                          sns.publish(PhoneNumber=addr or os.environ["WHATSAPP_SENDER_ID"],Message=body)
                      else:
                          sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ["DELIVERY_STATUS_TOPIC_ARN"],Message=json.dumps({"campaignId":cid,"messageId":mid,"channel":ch,"status":"SENT"}))
                  except Exception as e:
                      st="FAILED";dt=str(e)
                  now=int(time.time())
                  DELIV.put_item(Item={"messageId":mid,"campaignId":cid,"recordType":"DELIVERY","customerId":x.get("customerId",""),"channel":ch,"deliveryStatus":st,"detail":dt[:1000],"createdAt":now,"expiresAt":now+7776000})
                  res.append({"messageId":mid,"channel":ch,"status":st})
              p["deliveryResults"]=res
              return p
          def record(p):
              cid=p["campaignId"];res=p.get("deliveryResults",[]);sc={};cc={}
              for i in res:
                  sc[i["status"]]=sc.get(i["status"],0)+1
                  cc[i["channel"]]=cc.get(i["channel"],0)+1
              summ={"campaignId":cid,"totalMessages":len(res),"statusCounts":sc,"channelCounts":cc}
              DELIV.put_item(Item={"messageId":"CAMPAIGN#"+cid,"campaignId":cid,"recordType":"CAMPAIGN_SUMMARY","campaignStatus":"COMPLETED","summary":json.dumps(summ),"updatedAt":int(time.time())})
              sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ["ALERT_TOPIC_ARN"],Subject="Campaign completed: "+cid,Message=json.dumps(summ))
              p["campaignStatus"]="COMPLETED"
              return p
          STAGES={"parse":parse,"segment":segment,"predict":predict,"safety":safety,"adapt":adapt,"deliver":deliver,"record":record}
          def handler(event,context):
              return STAGES[event["stage"]](event.get("payload",{}))

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SimpleTodoAPI - an AppSync GraphQL API for a simple to-do list, backed by a DynamoDB table with an owner global secondary index, encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key, and implemented entirely with APPSYNC_JS JavaScript resolvers. Every resource is created by this template.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the to-do table at rest
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTableKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used for at-rest encryption of the SimpleTodoAPI to-do table.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stable, readable alias for the to-do table key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTableKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/simpletodoapi/table
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TodoTableKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table for to-do items: partition key id, owner GSI for by-owner lookups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TodoTableKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service role that AppSync assumes to read and write the to-do table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncTodoDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: AppSync service role granting access to the to-do table and its owner index.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppSyncToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TodoTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowTodoTableOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API (schema is attached via a separate GraphQLSchema resource)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SimpleTodoAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SimpleTodoAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL SDL for the to-do API, attached to SimpleTodoAPI
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SimpleTodoApiSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String!
          description: String
          status: TodoStatus
          done: Boolean
          owner: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime
        }

        enum TodoStatus {
          PENDING
          IN_PROGRESS
          DONE
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          title: String!
          description: String
          status: TodoStatus
          done: Boolean
          owner: String
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          description: String
          status: TodoStatus
          done: Boolean
          owner: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          todosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API key for testing (valid until 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SimpleTodoApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      Description: API key used for straightforward testing of SimpleTodoAPI.
      Expires: 1767225600

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single DynamoDB data source used by all six JavaScript resolvers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      Name: TodoTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source over the to-do table.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncTodoDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation: createTodo (PutItem, generates id and timestamps when absent)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const id = input.id || util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({
              ...input,
              id,
              createdAt: now,
              updatedAt: now,
            }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation: updateTodo (UpdateItem scoped by the id part of the input)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = { ...ctx.args.input };
          const id = input.id;
          delete input.id;

          const updates = Object.entries(input).filter((entry) => {
            return entry[1] !== null && entry[1] !== undefined;
          });
          updates.push(['updatedAt', util.time.nowISO8601()]);

          const expressionNames = {};
          const expressionValues = {};
          const assignments = updates.map((entry) => {
            expressionNames[`#${entry[0]}`] = entry[0];
            expressionValues[`:${entry[0]}`] = entry[1];
            return `#${entry[0]} = :${entry[0]}`;
          });

          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            update: {
              expression: `SET ${assignments.join(', ')}`,
              expressionNames,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(expressionValues),
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation: deleteTodo (DeleteItem scoped by the id argument only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query: getTodo (GetItem by the id argument)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query: listTodos (Scan with limit/nextToken so results are bounded)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const request = {
            operation: 'Scan',
            limit: ctx.args.limit || 20,
          };
          if (ctx.args.nextToken) {
            request.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          return request;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return {
            items: ctx.result.items,
            nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken,
          };
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query: todosByOwner (Query against the owner global secondary index)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const request = {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'owner-index',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': ctx.args.owner }),
            },
            limit: ctx.args.limit || 20,
          };
          if (ctx.args.nextToken) {
            request.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          return request;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return {
            items: ctx.result.items,
            nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken,
          };
        }

Outputs:

  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the SimpleTodoAPI GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The GraphQL endpoint URL of the SimpleTodoAPI API.
    Value: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.GraphQLUrl

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: The ID of the API key created for testing SimpleTodoAPI.
    Value: !GetAtt SimpleTodoApiKey.ApiKeyId

  TodoTableName:
    Description: The name of the DynamoDB to-do table.
    Value: !Ref TodoTable

  TodoTableKeyArn:
